title: Senior Statisticien RWE
description: Join Excelya , where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a Statistics team overseeing Real-World Evidence (RWE), non-interventional, and Secondary Use of Data (SUD) studies. You will provide statistical leadership, review study protocols and analysis plans, supervise external service providers, ensure the quality and timely delivery of statistical outputs, and work closely with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation and regulatory reporting Key Responsibilities : - Review study synopses and protocols, including sample size calculations, study design, endpoints, and statistical methodologies. - Oversee statistical deliverables from external service providers, including Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), TFLs, and interim analyses. - Monitor study statistical milestones and track operational progress through vendor dashboards. - Ensure the timely delivery of statistical outputs and analysis datasets in compliance with Ipsen quality standards. - Perform quality control of statistical analyses, including SAS programming and programming validation activities. - Review clinical study reports (CSRs) and all external communications related to study results and analyses. - Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Biometry, Clinical Operations, Medical teams, and external partners. - Ensure complete and accurate maintenance of study documentation, including accountability for eTMF completion. Requirements At Excelya, we encourage everyone to be bold, challenge themselves, and unlock their full potential. We are looking for professionals who share our values and are eager to grow in a dynamic and stimulating environment. Education : Master’s degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, or a related scientific discipline. Experience : Very strong experience in statistics and statistical programming within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, including significant exposure to Real-World Evidence (RWE), non-interventional studies, and Secondary Use of Data (SUD) projects Skills : Hands-on experience with SAS programming and statistical validation. Experience with R and/or large healthcare databases (claims databases, EHR/EMR, registries) is considered a strong asset. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional and international environment. Languages : Fluent English, both written and spoken. Benefits Why join us? At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare. Here's what makes us unique: We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience. Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey. Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission. title: Senior Product Manager - Zero-Day Protection
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>Location: Austin, TX, London, UK, New York, NY</p> <p>New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.</p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 25% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.</p> <h1><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Responsibilities</span></h1> <h2>Product strategy and roadmap</h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.</li> <li>Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.</li> <li>Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.</li> <li>Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.</li> <li>Partner with the Cloudflare Security Analyst team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Analysts provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.</li> <li>Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.</li> <li>Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Customer experience</h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation</li> <li>Ensure customers can understand what protections they have, what events mean, and what action to take.</li> <li>Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. Turn recurring friction and unmet needs into product priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>Operations and communications</h2> <ul> <li>Support the Security Analyst team’s vulnerability-response work by providing product context and customer perspective</li> <li>Coordinate responsible disclosure and external vulnerability communications with Security, Legal, and Communications</li> <li>Write technical posts, customer guidance, and product communications for security researchers, customers, press, and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in the broader security community, at conferences, and online as a product and technical spokesperson for Managed Rules and HTTP application vulnerabilities</li> </ul> <h2>Skills Required </h2> <ul> <li>Strong product-management experience, including strategy, roadmap ownership, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional delivery.</li> <li>Technical fluency to understand HTTP applications, vulnerabilities, exploits, and detection systems.</li> <li>Ability to synthesize input from security analysts, engineers, customers, and commercial teams into clear product decisions.</li> <li>Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous security environment.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across Security Analysts, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Security research, exploit-development, or detection-engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience with WAFs, managed rules, security-rule rollout, false-positive management, application security, threat intelligence, security operations or vulnerability management.</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise security operations, including APIs, automation, auditability, policy controls, logs, and SIEM integrations.</li> <li>Experience with code scanning, software supply-chain security, or exposure discovery.</li> <li>An established presence in the security research community, conference speaking, technical writing, or press engagement.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Lisbon </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of 65,000 - 80,000 EURO</li> <li>For <strong>New York City </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $216,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Stage Public Affairs Burson Nederland
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Stage Public Affairs bij Burson</strong></p> <p><strong>Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?</strong></p> <p>Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.</p> <p>Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.</p> <p>Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.</p> <p>Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.</p> <p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p> <p>Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.</p> <p><strong>Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:</strong>dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.</li> <li><strong>Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:</strong>bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.</li> <li><strong>Verslaglegging</strong>: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.</li> <li><strong>Research en analyse</strong>: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholdermapping</strong>: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.</li> <li><strong>Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten</strong>: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).</li> <li>Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.</li> <li>Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.</li> <li>Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.</li> <li>Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.</li> <li>Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.</li> <li>Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij</strong></p> <p>Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals, consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om zo nu en dan eens vanuit huis te werken.</p> <p><strong>Solliciteren</strong></p> <p>Heb je interesse? Stuur dan uiterlijk 30 november je cv en motivatiebrief in via onderstaande link of naar:</p> <p>E: ----- <p>Joost Reede, T: 06 – 34 55 50 18,</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, Texas</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Our centralized Developer Go-to-Market (GTM) organization functions as a "speedboat" to maintain focus, control direction, and iterate quickly. Our mission is to build long-term relationships with developers by addressing their unique needs and challenges with specialized attention and resources across Marketing, Developer Relations, Growth Programs, and Sales.</p> <p>Within Developer GTM, the Revenue Engineering team exists to build and evolve GTM infrastructure to support Cloudflare’s transition into a major cloud provider and drive Cloudflare’s AI transformation. We operate across data platform development, application platforms, core pipeline evolution, and novel internal product delivery enabling teams across the organization to move fast without accumulating unmaintainable technical debt.</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></h1> <p>As a hands-on "player-coach" Engineering Manager on the Revenue Engineering team, you will balance technical leadership with direct execution, actively writing code, building pipelines, prototyping novel GTM applications, and debugging alongside your team. You will lead, coach, and grow a team of high-performing software and data engineers building mission-critical GTM software, data platforms, and internal developer tools on top of Cloudflare's own developer platform (Workers, Kubernetes, Go, TypeScript, SQL, and MCP). You will take ownership of our core platform strategy, balancing fast-paced feature delivery with platform maintainability, data integrity, and operational excellence.</p> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and Grow Engineering Talent (Player-Coach Model):</strong> Recruit, mentor, and develop a diverse team of talented software and data engineers while leading by example through active code contributions, hands-on technical guidance, and unblocking engineers directly in the codebase.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Build Platform Primitives:</strong> Set the technical vision and actively write code for our GTM Data Platform, App Platform, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations in Go and TypeScript, enabling internal teams to build and scale maintainable solutions.</li> <li><strong>Prototype & Deliver High-Impact Applications:</strong> Directly build and prototype novel GTM applications (Signals, Customer Health, Cost Explorer), evolve core pipelines (Salesforce enrichment, customer contact ingestion, real-time consumption billing visibility), and implement data infrastructure migrations.</li> <li><strong>Empower & Advise Business silos.</li> <li><strong>Drive Operational & Engineering Excellence:</strong> Establish best practices for service observability, testing, schema evolution, and deployment while mitigating bus-factor risks and single points of failure across legacy and new systems.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Developer Relations, BI, Security, and Product to align on business priorities, unblock dependencies, and turn complex business challenges into reliable software solutions.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: external platforms.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatic Business Execution:</strong> Ability to navigate ambiguous problem spaces, balance rapid prototyping ("learning mode") with scalable platform Experience with modern columnar databases / lakehouses (ClickHouse, DuckDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, Iceberg) or analytics engineering workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
description: Role summary: At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done. We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use. This role is focused on research , including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave , and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects. We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions. How you’ll work You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform. You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence. You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab. Key responsibilities: Hybrid bioprocess modelling Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data. Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics. Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data. Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations. Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings. Transfer across organisms and scales Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast. Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data. Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up. Real-time Model-Predictive Control Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically. Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation). Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity. Qualifications: PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience. Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish. Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions. Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn). Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches. Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration. Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners. Nice-to-have: Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS) Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars) Benefits: Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines; Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work; A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel eGym WellPass membership Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you. Team Culture We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it. About the Role As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training. Your Responsibilities Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency. Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale. Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien. Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje: Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring; Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework; Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels. Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events. Dit vullen we graag aan met: Een goed salaris passend bij jouw niveau en ervaring; Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: Een 13e maand, 8% vakantiegeld, Vitaliteitsbudget, WIA-hiaat verzekering en een pensioenregeling; 30 vakantiedagen om op te laden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden; Persoonlijke groei: Een uitgebreide onboarding, ruim persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget en coaching; Een gezellige werkplek inclusief een volle kalender met teamactiviteiten, uitjes en spontane borrels. Wat wij doen? Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen. Wij helpen machinebouwers wereldwijd om hun activiteiten te stroomlijnen en hun service naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Dit doen we met een pakket aan innovatieve oplossingen: van veilige remote access tot klantenportalen en geavanceerde data dashboarding. Onze oplossingen zijn ontworpen om zonder beperkingen mee te schalen en naadloos te integreren, zodat onze klanten hun services maximaal kunnen optimaliseren. Klaar om impact te maken? We houden van een laagdrempelige aanpak. Na een korte eerste kennismaking laten we je graag een live demo van ons platform zien. Zo ontdek je precies hoe en wat wij bouwen. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart. Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten. Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij? title: Engineering Manager, Bots & Fraud
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; Washington D.C.; New York City</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team builds the products that answer "Can we trust this traffic?" Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.</li> <li>You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.</li> <li>You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.</li> <li>You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.</li> <li>You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team building and scaling Cloudflare's products for bot management, fraud detection, and abuse mitigation. You will recruit, mentor, and grow talented engineers, provide technical leadership, and partner closely with Product Management to shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</p> <p>You will partner with detection and research teams to turn their signals into reliable, performant, and easy-to-use customer solutions. Our systems span real-time services running across Cloudflare's global network, APIs and configuration, and high-volume data and analytics pipelines. You will collaborate across engineering and product teams to bring new capabilities into production and continuously improve the customer experience.</p> <h3><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team.</strong> Hire, mentor, and empower engineers through clear feedback, thoughtful career development, and a culture of ownership and technical excellence.</li> <li><strong>Shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</strong> Partner with Product Management to translate customer problems into incremental deliverables, balancing new capabilities with reliability, performance, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership.</strong> Participate in design discussions and guide decisions about scalable distributed services, product integrations, APIs, and analytics.</li> <li><strong>Turn detection signals into customer capabilities.</strong> Partner with detection and research teams to deliver actionable analytics and configurable controls, helping customers balance security, user experience, and privacy.</li> <li><strong>Measure and improve customer outcomes.</strong> Work with Product and detection partners to use feedback and production data to improve effectiveness, reduce unnecessary friction, and make products easier to adopt.</li> <li><strong>Own operational health.</strong> Ensure your team's services have effective observability, safe releases, incident response, and follow-through on improvements.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-team execution.</strong> Resolve dependencies, align priorities across teams, and work with customer-facing partners to address recurring product problems at their roots.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building bot management, fraud detection, application security, or other products that make decisions in an adversarial environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with HTTP, browser technologies, JavaScript, and the tradeoffs between security, privacy, and user experience.</li> <li>Experience integrating machine learning models into production systems or partnering closely with data science and machine learning teams.</li> <li>Experience with high-volume data pipelines, analytics services, or columnar databases such as ClickHouse.</li> <li>Experience with technologies used in our systems, such as Go, Rust, Python, Kafka, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Washington D.C. & New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $261,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Systems Engineer, MAPS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>New York, NY<br>Washington, DC<br>San Francisco, CA</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s architecture is built on a homogeneous edge: every server in over 330 cities runs every service—from L4/L7 proxies (FL2, Pingora) and DNS to the Workers runtime, cache, and storage. While this design maximizes hardware utilization, it creates a difficult distributed attribution problem. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL. Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability. Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team. Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on. Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work. Plus points: Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced. Dutch, German or French. An interest in cycling. Benefits 🌟 Our perks 🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!) 📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join 💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually 🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year 💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future 💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost) 🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours 💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun! 🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!) 👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family 🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts 🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions 🌈 Belonging at Laka We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment as part of our application or assessment process, please let us know by emailing View email address on apply.workable.com To find out more about what it’s like to work at Laka, visit our careers page here . title: Senior AI Security Engineer
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. </p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. </p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p><strong>ROLE SUMMARY</strong></p> <p>The Senior AI Security Engineer, AI Products & Applications will be embedded within the AI & Applications team to enable the secure design, development, release, and operation of AI products and applications. The role works directly with AI engineers, application engineers, product managers, inference engineers, DevOps, and platform teams to build practical security controls into agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model-serving APIs, enterprise-data integrations, and user-facing AI experiences.</p> <p>This is a product- and application-oriented security role. The engineer will help teams deliver trusted AI features without unnecessarily slowing innovation, while ensuring that AI products protect customer, enterprise, and operational data. The role reports operationally to the Head of AI & Applications, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of Cybersecurity to maintain alignment with enterprise security strategy, risk management, compliance requirements, and incident-response processes.</p> <p><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with AI product, application, and engineering teams from discovery through production to define secure-by-design architectures for AI-powered products and services.</li> <li>Threat-model LLM-enabled and agentic workflows, including direct and indirect prompt injection, data exfiltration, unsafe tool use, excessive agent permissions, cross-tenant access, model abuse, and unintended autonomous actions.</li> <li>Design secure patterns for agent identity, delegated authorization, scoped credentials, tool allowlists, approval gates, action validation, execution sandboxing, rollback, and auditability.</li> <li>Secure RAG and enterprise-knowledge workflows, including document ingestion, indexing, retrieval permissions, metadata filtering, source attribution, tenant isolation, sensitive-data classification, and data-retention controls.</li> <li>Define security controls for user-facing AI products, including authentication, authorization, consent, rate limiting, abuse detection, content and output controls, conversation-data handling, and customer-facing audit trails.</li> <li>Secure model-serving and inference APIs through workload identity, API authentication, tenant-aware access controls, quotas, request validation, model access policies, usage monitoring, and logging controls.</li> <li>Build reusable AI security guardrails, libraries, reference architectures, templates, policy-as-code, and developer tooling that make secure implementation the default path for product teams.</li> <li>Work with DevOps and Platform teams to ensure Kubernetes, custom job-scheduler integrations, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, containers, and runtime environments provide the required security posture for AI applications.</li> <li>Lead vulnerability management for AI application dependencies, model-serving runtimes, agent frameworks, SDKs, APIs, containers, CUDA and GPU software components, and related infrastructure.</li> <li>Embed security requirements into application design reviews, pull-request and CI/CD controls, release processes, operational runbooks, and incident-response procedures.</li> <li>Develop security telemetry and detections for anomalous agent actions, unsafe tool calls, unusual data retrieval, credential misuse, inference API abuse, suspicious workload behavior, and policy violations.</li> <li>Act as the principal security liaison between AI & Applications and the Cybersecurity function, coordinating architecture reviews, security exceptions, risk acceptance, compliance evidence, incident response, and remediation tracking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, cloud security, platform security, or a related field.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience embedding security practices into software engineering or product-development teams and supporting secure delivery from design through production.</li> <li>Strong understanding of application security, API description: IT Medewerker – Eerste Lijns Service Engineer Ben jij die IT-held die energie krijgt van het helpen van mensen, houdt van virtuele omgevingen en SaaS-oplossingen, en een passie heeft voor techniek? We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij IT-vragen of problemen . Zo weet je bijvoorbeeld wat het verschil is tussen een TAC en TAC 2 LAN netwerk of je kan rechten correct toewijzen in SharePoint. En minstens zo belangrijk: naast hard werken, vinden we het ook belangrijk om lol te hebben. Zo lunchen we dagelijks samen (op kosten van de baas), ligt er altijd vers fruit klaar, en sporten we wekelijks onder begeleiding van een personal trainer. Een of twee keer per jaar trekken we eropuit voor een teamuitje – gewoon, omdat het gezellig is.
