title: Global Senior Program Manager
description: Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. Your main responsibilities are: Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. Why do you want this position? Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. What do we offer? At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for. At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success. In addition, we offer: A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background. revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary. Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days). Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business. Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. Who are you? Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results. Furthermore, we are looking for: 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities. Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery. Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel. If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch! Serious Tech At Benchmark, you work on products that make a real impact through innovation, whether by improving safety, enhancing healthcare, or making everyday life easier. From product design and engineering to volume production and, in some cases, direct delivery to end users, the entire process takes place at our Almelo facility, where you will work alongside approximately 650 colleagues. We develop and manufacture innovative solutions for industries including semiconductor, healthcare, aerospace, and industrial markets. From concept to production, the complete product lifecycle comes together under one roof. While the technical challenges are significant, our culture remains down-to-earth and approachable. You will work with people who take ownership, support one another, and continuously strive for improvement. Seriously you? We are looking for people who are energized by complex technology and are motivated by challenging work. People who take initiative, share ideas, and enjoy working together to make things better every day. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! title: Ingénieur.e de recherche (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
description: Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite. ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables. Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis). DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne. Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis. Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales. L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie. Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : • Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle • Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie • Bonnes compétences en programmation Capacités et aptitudes : • Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse • Autonomie et esprit d’initiative • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire • Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais PROFIL RECHERCHE : Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe. Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière. Principales responsabilités A. Contrôle de gestion sociale et pilotage de la masse salariale Construire le budget annuel de masse salariale et des effectifs, en lien avec la DRH, la Direction Financière et les équipes opérationnelles. Élaborer les prévisions actualisées (forecasts) et les projections de fin d'année. Analyser les écarts entre réalisé, budget et prévisions, et identifier les principaux facteurs explicatifs. Modéliser les effets des évolutions d'effectifs, des augmentations salariales, des promotions, des bonus, des départs et des recrutements. Réaliser des simulations financières pour accompagner les décisions RH : recrutements, réorganisations, politiques de rémunération et évolution des effectifs. Suivre les principaux indicateurs économiques et sociaux : masse salariale, effectifs, rémunération moyenne, coûts des recrutements et autres coûts RH. Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus de contrôle et de fiabilisation des données de paie et de rémunération. Préparer les analyses nécessaires aux revues budgétaires et aux présentations destinées au CODIR. B. HR Data Analytics et aide à la décision Exploiter et croiser les données issues du SIRH, de la paie, du recrutement et des autres outils RH. Analyser les tendances RH et identifier les principaux facteurs d'évolution des indicateurs sociaux. Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur le turnover, l'absentéisme, le recrutement, la mobilité interne, les rémunérations et les parcours professionnels. Identifier les populations, métiers ou entités nécessitant une attention particulière et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles. Développer des analyses permettant d'évaluer l'efficacité des politiques RH et d'en mesurer les résultats. Concevoir des analyses prospectives et, lorsque les données le permettent, des modèles de prévision pour anticiper les évolutions des effectifs et des indicateurs sociaux. Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers. C. Reporting, Business Intelligence et automatisation Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord RH et les reportings destinés à la DRH, au CODIR et aux équipes opérationnelles. Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats. Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique. Harmoniser les définitions, les règles de calcul et les référentiels des indicateurs RH. Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité, de la cohérence et de la disponibilité des données sociales. Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'optimisation des processus de collecte et d'exploitation des données. D. Projets RH Participer activement à l’ensemble des exercices annuels liés aux sujets Comp & Ben : Révision annuelle des salaires, évaluation des bonus, plan de commissionnement pour les équipes de vente. Etudes de rémunérations, benchmarks internes et externes. Profil recherché Formation Bac +5 en contrôle de gestion, finance, statistiques, data analytics, ressources humaines ou école de commerce avec spécialisation pertinente. Une double compétence en finance et en data constitue un atout. Expérience 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion sociale, HR Analytics, contrôle de gestion ou analyse de données, idéalement avec une exposition aux problématiques RH. Une expérience dans le retail, la mode, le luxe ou un environnement multi-entités est appréciée. Compétences techniques Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des fonctions avancées d'analyse de données. Bonne maîtrise de Power BI. Capacité à manipuler, consolider et analyser des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes. Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de masse salariale, des rémunérations, des effectifs et des principaux indicateurs sociaux. Capacité à construire des modèles budgétaires, des prévisions et des analyses de sensibilité. La connaissance du système de paie ADP est un avantage. Doté d’un esprit analytique, vous êtes rigoureux et proactif, vous comprenez l’environnement Business, et êtes à l’aise dans la collaboration avec les différents départements. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The Role As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data. You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs. This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver. You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different. What Excites You Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions. Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible. Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions. Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges. Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work. Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility. Responsibilities Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges. Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements. Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios. Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions. Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made. Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation. Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations. Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions. Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering. Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows. What Excites Us Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions. Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles. Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements. Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others. Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward. Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders. Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built. Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers. Bonus / Nice to Have Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics. Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration. Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders. Our Values In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes. Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead. Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are. Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise. Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust. Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Accounts Payable & Financial Controller
description: Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI. Wat je gaat doen Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar. Je stuurt een team van werkstudenten en stagiaires aan en zorgt er samen met hen voor dat alle facturen tijdig en correct worden verwerkt. Je ondersteunt bij de maandafsluiting, controleert grootboekrekeningen en helpt mee met ad-hoc analyses en periodieke rapportages. Je denkt actief mee over het slim inrichten van financiële workflows. Je verkent en implementeert mogelijkheden voor procesautomatisering, slimme datakoppelingen en AI-oplossingen (zoals OCR-herkenning en geautomatiseerde factuurverwerking). Je rapporteert aan de Lead Financial Controller, die je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse werkzaamheden en je helpt om door te groeien in je rol. Dit ben jij Als ideale kandidaat heb je al een basis aan kennis en ervaring en wil je blijven leren in een vakgebied dat continu verandert en digitaliseert. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel: Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy). Je hebt 0-3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële of control-functie. Je hebt ervaring met de crediteurenadministratie en het verwerken en controleren van facturen. Kennis van accountingsoftware (zoals Exact) is een pré. Je bent handig met data en hebt een sterke affiniteit met automatisering en nieuwe technologieën (zoals AI-tools, data-integraties en procesoptimalisatie). Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Je bent integer, nauwkeurig en risicobewust. Je begrijpt dat een strakke administratie de basis vormt voor goede besluitvorming. Je denkt in kansen en mogelijkheden: je ziet direct waar processen sneller, slimmer of foutlozer kunnen en schroomt niet om dit op te pakken. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Audit Methodology Lead
description: We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar. You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What you'll own Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it What you'll bring A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions Recent experience across several clients and industries Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion Nice to have: You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up What this role is not Not product management. title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials. Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations. Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure. Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment. Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team. Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams. Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them. Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions. Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates. Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes. Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures. Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result. Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor. Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection. Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners. Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division. Your Profile: Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering. 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries. Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics. Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles. Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy. Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements. Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers. Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable. Experience leading technical work with material suppliers. Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial. Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial. title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight. This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence. Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware. Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements. Seven or more years of experience developing complex electronic hardware from architecture through verification and production release. Proven experience with BMS hardware, battery-monitoring electronics or comparable high-channel-count, safety-critical mixed-signal systems. Strong expertise in precision analogue measurement, ADC signal chains, filtering, current and voltage sensing, galvanic isolation and fault-tolerant power supplies. Demonstrable experience designing high-density multilayer electronics, including HDI technology, fine-pitch BGA/QFN devices, microvias, power distribution, grounding and thermal constraints. Strong digital-hardware knowledge involving microcontrollers, memories, watchdogs, CAN/CAN FD, SPI, I²C and isolated serial interfaces. title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)

You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements. Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes. Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration. Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers. With a hospitality mindset and strong communication skills, you take pride in delivering excellent service and building a space that reflects our culture and values.</p> <p>This role reports to the <strong>Regional Manager, Workplace Operations</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><em>Workplace Experience:</em></strong> Ensure our hub is a functional, inspiring space that reflects our culture and supports hybrid work. Act as the first point of contact for employee workplace needs, solving issues quickly and thoughtfully.</li> <li><strong><em>Stay Connected Across Channels:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Maintain clear, responsive communication with the local team across platforms like chat, email, and in-person touchpoints—ensuring everyone stays informed, supported, and aligned on workplace updates and needs.</li> <li><strong><em>Track and Report Workplace Metrics: </em></strong>Monitor key data points such as space utilization, occupancy, and service ticket volume to support data-driven decision-making and long-term planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Workplace Programs: </em></strong>Help drive local implementation of global workplace programs—from our food program (think snack stocking, team lunches, and special food moments) and sustainability initiatives to employee engagement efforts.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Internal Events & Experiences:</em></strong> Plan and execute a range of onsite events—including team onsites, in-person weeks, executive briefings, customer meetings, and cultural moments—both independently and in collaboration with the Global Events & Experiences team, ensuring each gathering is seamless, engaging, and reflective of our culture.</li> <li><strong><em>Safety & Compliance:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Partner with Security and Legal teams to maintain a safe and compliant workplace. Support emergency preparedness efforts, safety drills, and incident response protocols.</li> <li><strong><em>Scale Smartly</em></strong><strong>: </strong>As the hub grows, help onboard new team members, support hiring needs for workplace roles, and participate in long-term workplace planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support the Regional Places Team:</em></strong> Assist with administrative tasks such as responding to tickets, managing emails and inquiries, and providing holiday coverage to ensure seamless team operations across regions.</li> <li><strong><em>Lead Onsite Operations:</em></strong> Own the day-to-day management of the workplace—from front desk services, greeting guests/employees/visiting employees, and mail handling to office supplies, swag, deliveries, and space readiness. You’ll make sure everything flows, looks great, and feels seamless for employees and visitors alike.</li> <li><strong><em>Be the go-to for Vendors and Places Team:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Liaise with building management, building security, and external vendors (cleaning crews, caterers, property managers, etc.) to keep our operations running efficiently. Oversee vendor performance and contracts, lead RFPs when needed, and track workplace budgets responsibly.</li> <li><strong><em>Create a World-Class Environment:</em></strong> Champion an inspiring, inclusive, and vibrant office culture. Plan and execute engaging onsite events, team celebrations, catering, and daily amenities that make coming into the office exciting, productive, and memorable for our team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Have 5+ years of experience leading workplace operations teams, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including 3+ years of people management experience.</li> <li>Are people-first and service-minded, with a friendly, professional presence that makes everyone feel welcome</li> <li>Know how to juggle vendors, projects, and priorities—and still sweat the small stuff</li> <li>Bring sharp budget management skills and make thoughtful, cost-effective decisions</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently across all levels and time zones using Google Workspace</li> <li>Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—you spot what needs doing before anyone else does</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving environments, stay calm under pressure, and love finding creative solutions</li> <li>Have experience collaborating cross-functionally with teams like IT, Security, People Ops, and more</li> <li>Bring a hospitality mindset and a passion for building inspiring, functional spaces where people love to work</li> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday).</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Manager Organisational Transformation
description: About the job Please note that fluency in Dutch is mandatory for this role. Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness? At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organisational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters. What will you do? Your primary focus lies in the organisational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective organisational design take a centre stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain. Your responsibilities will include: Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimisation of processes to designing and implementing new business models. Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organisational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best. Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management. Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients. Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development. Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present. Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the People & Organisational Transformation competence team, and primary Organisational Transformation. What do you bring to the table? A completed bachelor’s and master’s degree with a numerical component. At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy. At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models. The ability to translate strategic goals into implications for employees. We don’t stop at design; we support our clients through implementation. Our integrated transformation projects connect strategy, data, AI and organisational change. An interest in data, AI, change management and the human side of change is therefore essential. Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders. Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills. Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships. Fluent in Dutch and English. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritises and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the number of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organises both professional and social events. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly using the button on this page or get in touch with our recruitment team to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. title: Senior Named Account Executive ( Northern VA/DC Metro)

title: Deal Intelligence Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon </p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></p> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Intelligence Analyst, you will be the analytical engine driving our transition to a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk. Sitting within the Finance function, you will design the data systems and executive dashboards that allow our deal architects to analyze complex deal terms, protect margins, and close large, complex commitment deals with unprecedented velocity.</p> <p>This role is designed for a "full-stack" analyst. You won't just be querying pre-cleaned data—you possess the technical skills to build the pipelines that feed your insights. You will leverage Cloudflare's Developer Platform (Workers, R2, D1, Workers AI) alongside standard data warehousing tools to extract raw CRM and CPQ data, integrate it into AI workflows, and deliver actionable insights that directly impact margin preservation and our global growth.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build Advanced Dashboards & Analytics: Design and maintain executive dashboards and self-serve reporting systems that provide real-time visibility into deal terms, discount thresholds, win/loss rates, and margin performance across all regions.</li> <li>Transform Ideas into Reality: Work with stakeholders and help them refine their ideas and goals into queries that we’ll automate.</li> <li>Drive Strategic Margin Analysis: Partner closely with Finance, Infrastructure and Deal Desk leadership to dive deep into historic and active pricing data, uncovering insights that ensure our quoting strategies consistently align with margin preservation goals.</li> <li>Develop Data Pipelines: Apply your data engineering skills to build and maintain data cleansing tools that help refine data from Salesforce, CPQ, and billing systems, transforming it into clean, usable semantic models.</li> <li>Power AI Workflows: Assist in integrating structured deal data into Deal Desk tools to help automate routine approvals and surface real-time pricing optimizations to deal managers.</li> <li>Data Storytelling & Enablement: Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders, empowering the Deal Desk team to use your data products for faster, data-driven negotiations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>3-5+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a technical RevOps role, with a strong emphasis on full-stack data problem solving.</li> <li>Experience incorporating data into AI workflows, utilizing LLM orchestration frameworks, or building predictive models.</li> <li>Proven experience designing analytical data models; domain expertise in financial and SaaS metrics (e.g. margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR) is a strong plus</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.</li> <li>Experience designing analytical data models specifically tailored for financial and SaaS business analysis (e.g., margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR).</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud data platforms and an interest in edge computing/serverless architectures (Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1).</li> <li>Expertise, or interest in learning, CRM data structures (especially Salesforce custom objects), CPQ complexities, and the quote-to-cash lifecycle.</li> <li>Solid communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data systems and operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background working closely with Deal Desk, Finance, RevOps or Sales Strategy teams at a high-growth SaaS or technology company is a plus</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.</li> <li>SQL and deep proficiency in modern data visualization and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Sigma, PowerBI) to build intuitive executive reporting.</li> <li>Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and orchestration tools (like Airflow).</li> <li>Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or other analytics databases</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws

title: Key Account Sales Executive
description: Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first) Team description Our Paris sales team helps small and growing merchants across France get set up with SumUp's payment tools, often as their very first introduction to the brand. We're a close-knit, target-driven group that thrives on outbound conversations, quick thinking and celebrating wins together. This role gives you a real seat at the table from day one: you'll own conversations end to end, learn the fundamentals of a fast-paced sales cycle and see the direct impact of your work every time a merchant signs up. What you'll do 💼 Reach out to small business prospects by phone, email and social media, starting the conversation and building the pipeline 🤝 Get to know each business's needs and show how SumUp can genuinely help them 🎤 Run product pitches and demos that turn curiosity into commitment 🔥 Manage the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal 📊 Track performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving 🧠 Share ideas with the team and help build an energised, collaborative office culture What we're looking for… Experience in outbound sales or business development, with a genuine drive to learn and grow quickly. Comfort working with high volumes of phone-based outreach. Curiosity and confidence when speaking with new people and solving their problems. A results-driven mindset with a track record of working towards targets. Fluency in French and English, given daily contact with local merchants and a global team. Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future 🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance 🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn , Instagram , and TikTok . title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it. While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 20k to € 200k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom. Minimum requirements for this role: The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch. Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume. Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV. Native French language An ideal candidate also offers: Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain. A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results. A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy. Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . title: Referent (w/m/d) Vertriebssteuerung und -strategie
description: Über die Nord-Ostsee Sparkasse Wie schön, dass du dich für uns als Arbeitgeber interessierst. Wir sind eine der größten Sparkassen Deutschlands mit 40 Filialen und einer Bilanzsumme von über 8 Mrd. Euro. Als Marktführerin in unserer Region engagieren wir uns für vielfältige gesellschaftliche Projekte und wurden mehrfach als beliebteste Bank ausgezeichnet. Doch was uns vor allem antreibt, sind die Zufriedenheit unserer 270.000 Kundinnen und Kunden und das Wohlbefinden unserer über 800 Mitarbeitenden. Bei uns erwarten dich Teamwork, interessante Jobprofile, vielfältige Entwicklungswege und ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer der schönsten Regionen Deutschlands. Du hast Lust uns kennenzulernen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt. Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind Sparkasse. Deine Mission: Du möchtest nicht nur Zahlen analysieren, sondern daraus konkrete Impulse für den Vertrieb ableiten? Du interessierst dich dafür, wie aus der Unternehmensstrategie konkrete Ziele für Produkte, Kundensegmente und Vertriebseinheiten entstehen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzung und entwickelst den Vertrieb zukunftsorientiert weiter. Du hast Markt und Kund:innen im Blick, erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und sorgst dafür, dass aus strategischen Ideen konkrete Maßnahmen werden. Folgende Aufgaben warten auf dich: Du entwickelst die strategische sowie operative Produkt- und Geschäftsfeldplanung auf Basis der Unternehmensplanung und übersetzt strategische Zielsetzungen in konkrete Ziele. Du entwickelst Vertriebsstrategien kontinuierlich weiter und setzt neue Impulse – auf Basis der Geschäftsstrategie sowie aktueller und zukünftiger Marktentwicklungen. Du leitest daraus Zielgruppen-, Produkt- und Kommunikationsstrategien ab und entwickelst passende Ansätze für unsere Marktbearbeitung. Du übersetzt interne und externe Anforderungen in eine ganzheitliche, omnikanale Vertriebsstrategie und sorgst dafür, dass diese in der Praxis ankommt. Du hast unsere Vertriebsziele im Blick und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den relevanten Bereichen aussagekräftige KPIs und Messgrößen, mit denen der Vertrieb gezielt gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird. Du bringst den Vertrieb operativ weiter und übernimmst die verantwortliche Planung und Umsetzung vertrieblicher Projekte. Als Schnittstelle zu Verbänden, externen Partnern und weiteren Stakeholdern arbeitest du an zentralen Umsetzungsthemen mit. Du führst Markt-, Abweichungs- und Ursachenanalysen durch und interpretierst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst konkrete, passgenaue Maßnahmen für das Haus. Deine Fähigkeiten: Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus – vor allem aber hast du Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und auf den Punkt zu bringen.
