title: Senior Product Manager, Cloudflare Workers
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:  Austin or London</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p><a href="https://workers.cloudflare.com/solutions/platforms">Workers for Platforms</a> lets anyone build their own platform on top of <a href="https://workers.cloudflare.com/">Cloudflare’s Developer Platform</a>, turning Cloudflare’s infrastructure, compute and storage primitives into a programmable foundation others can build on.</p> <p>As a Product Manager for Workers for Platforms, you’ll define and execute the strategy that helps developers build platform businesses on top of Cloudflare. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, partnerships, and design to make Cloudflare’s primitives — Workers, Durable Objects, Agents, AI inference, and more — composable for any company to use as their own infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the strategy and roadmap for Workers for Platforms</li> <li>Work hands-on directly with some of Cloudflare’s biggest customers, every day</li> <li>Define the APIs, management layers, and developer experience that make it possible for customers to extend Cloudflare’s developer platform to their own customers.</li> <li>Get in the details of APIs we provide to developers, working closely with engineers</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare externally</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial-minded and thrives in a fast-paced and goal-driven environment. </p> <p>You do whatever it takes to ship and solve problems for customers — whether that means writing code, debugging with a customer, writing docs or learning how to do something new to you. Successful PMs at Cloudflare are unafraid to roll up sleeves, get into details and ask questions.</p> <ul> <li>You use AI effectively to move faster and learn faster.</li> <li>You show rather than tell — using code examples, demos, prototypes</li> <li>Developer focus — you’ll be working directly, and often be a part of the customers team in helping them get their initial implementation off the ground</li> <li>Strong technical abilities. You are capable of wading into the details & understanding engineering decisions’ impact on the product, but can also drive 30k foot view</li> <li>A desire to sweat the details and ship great developer experiences</li> <li>A love for talking to developers at organizations both large and small on a daily basis so that you can build and ship products that solve real problems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</strong></p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and </p> <p>benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <p>Medical/Rx InsuranceDental InsuranceVision InsuranceFlexible Spending AccountsCommuter Spending AccountsFertility & Family Forming BenefitsOn-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance ProgramGlobal Travel Medical Insurance</p> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <p>Short and Long Term Disability InsuranceLife & Accident Insurance401(k) Retirement Savings PlanEmployee Stock Participation Plan</p> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <p>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leaveLeave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)
description: Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast. We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. Not tickets. Outcomes. We call the role Product Engineer on purpose. You work directly with product, design, and practices, and you’re accountable for whether what you built actually solves the problem – not just for whether the code merged. What you’ll build Everyone works across the whole product; people build deeper expertise in some areas, but who works on what can change quickly. Over a typical quarter you’ll touch things like: • PMS integrations – connecting Roger to the practice management systems German practices run on, so our workflows sit on top of live practice data instead of beside it • Treatment plans and cost estimates (HKP) – turning a manual, error-prone paper process into something a practice team gets right the first time • Patient communication – recalls, reminders, and follow-ups that practices today handle by phone, fax, and sticky note • Revenue and billing workflows – helping practices bill what they actually did, correctly and on time • The Roger apps – web and Flutter clients that practice staff use all day, every day Whatever your area, you’ll own it from the first conversation with a practice to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked. What we expect • Own outcomes, not tasks. You define scope, timelines, and success criteria for your area, and you align stakeholders around them • Make technical decisions and stand behind them. Architecture, trade-offs, what to build versus buy – you decide, document why, and course-correct when the data says so • Know the system, not just your service. Roger is one product. You keep enough context across PMS integrations, data model, and clients to make decisions that hold up outside your corner • Raise the bar continuously. Testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability – you leave every area better than you found it • Shape how we work with AI. Our tooling and practices are still evolving. You contribute to them actively rather than waiting for a playbook • Enable others. Code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing – a senior here makes the people around them better How we work AI-native engineering, honestly described. Most of us run several coding agents in parallel, all day. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Reviewing it, testing it, and deciding what not to ship is. So here’s what that actually means for you: • You write specs and plans before you prompt. Skipping design thinking is where projects fail – not the AI • You review agent output with the same rigor as any PR. If you can’t explain what a module does, it doesn’t ship • You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system • Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance • You know the spectrum: when a throwaway prototype is fine and when full engineering discipline applies • You expect to spend as much time reviewing and validating as writing. If that sounds like a downgrade, this isn’t the right team. If it sounds like leverage, read on Patient data is not a detail. Roger handles health data (GDPR Art. 9) and sits inside practices bound by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB). Data minimization, access control, EU processing, and a clear head about what may go to which model provider are part of the engineering bar here – not a compliance checkbox someone else owns. Small team, short paths. You talk to practices, to product, and to the people who answer the phones for our customers. Decisions get made in a conversation, not a committee. Who you are • Senior-level, with significant experience shipping and operating production systems – you’ve been paged for your own code • A track record of owning projects end to end: from a vague problem statement through delivery to production and iteration • Used to working cross-functionally with product, design, data, and non-technical stakeholders – and comfortable talking to end users directly • You think beyond your own code: business context, user needs, and product goals shape what you build • You take ownership without waiting for instructions, make decisions under ambiguity, and escalate when it matters • You communicate openly and clearly, in writing and in person, with technical and non-technical people alike • Our stack is Ruby on Rails, Go, and Dart/Flutter. Deep experience in at least one of these helps; strong fundamentals matter more than any specific language • Bonus, not required: experience in healthcare, dental, or another regulated domain; or with integrating into legacy on-premise systems Location, language, and setup • Location: You live in Germany and can be in our Berlin office regularly. The role is hybrid: 2–3 days a week on site, the rest remote • German: Business-fluent German (C1 or better) is required. You’ll talk to practices, read PMS vendor documentation, and work with German regulatory and billing concepts daily. Our team language is English • Eligibility: You already hold the right to work in Germany. • Working hours: Full-time Why Roger? • The opportunity is absurd. A market worth billions that still runs on fax machines and phone tag • Real leverage. You’ll be one of 6 engineers. Your area is yours – your decisions shape the product, not a committee’s • Hard, interesting problems in a space most tech companies ignore: legacy integrations, regulated data, real-world workflows with real-world stakes • Engineers who care about craft. We argue about architecture, not politics • Compensation: €75,000 – €95,000 base salary depending on experience, plus equity participation and benefits: Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, 30 days’ vacation and Hrmony (50€ in-kind compensation). description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact </li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers. </li> </ul></div><h3><strong>Your Mission</strong></h3> <p>At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.<br>As a <em>Platform Engineer</em>, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build a self-service developer platform</strong> with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure</strong>, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.</li> <li><strong>Boost developer productivity</strong> by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.</li> <li><strong>Drive reliability and scalability</strong> through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.</li> <li><strong>Improve platform operations</strong> usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate and innovate</strong> by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h3> <p>You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.</p> <ul> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Cloud-native expertise</span>: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Automation mindset</span>: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Observability experience</span>: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Strong ownership</span>: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.</li> <li>Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Continuous learning</span>: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How We Work</strong></h3> <p>The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.</p> <ul> <li>We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.</li> <li>We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.</li> <li>We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Where You'll Be</strong></h3> <p>This is a <em>Hybrid</em> role based in Amsterdam. <strong>You will work from our </strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Amsterdam HQ</strong></span><strong> a minimum of 2 days per week.</strong><br>This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki <span style="text-decoration: underline;">can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location</span>, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.</p> <h3><strong>In Return</strong></h3> <p>You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of <strong>800+ Catawikians.</strong></p> <ul> <li>A competitive <span style="text-decoration: underline;">Annual Gross Base Salary</span> depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.</li> <li>A <span style="text-decoration: underline;">Work From Home</span> Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Commuting</span> between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.</li> <li>Amazing <span style="text-decoration: underline;">Office</span> right in the centre of Amsterdam.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Country Manager - Germany (Shift)
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. This is an incredible opportunity, to own Shift’s German operation, from business acquisition and data collection through logistics, team-building and delivery. Requirements Strong operational ownership: able to make local decisions, coordinate teams and take responsibility for delivery. Ability to win participation from businesses, particularly mid-sized businesses doing skilled, non-domestic tasks. Commercial judgment: build a local operation while operating as lean as possible. Practical logistics capability: maximise hardware, including distribution, returns, cleaning, uploads and loss prevention. Comfort building a team where justified by the economics, while working closely with Shift’s central team. Willingness to do hands-on, repetitive operational work, not only strategy or automation. Who Will Thrive at microagi Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership. DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. About the Role As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption. You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities. This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing. Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed. This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required. In this role, you will: Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes. Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes. Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews. Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels. Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities. Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations. Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions. Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations. Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation. Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders. Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline. Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation. Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS. Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles. Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys. Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities. Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up. Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting. Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity. Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership. Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions. Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation. Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion. Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity. Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders. Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly. Are fluent in German and English. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. title: Analytics Software Engineer
description: 🏨 The company Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care. We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources. Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real‑world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies. We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your role In a nutshell : You join the Data & Analytics team to build and scale key technical foundations (backend + modern data stack) so data is reliable, usable and accessible for clinical, research and business teams. Your impact : Increase delivery speed and trust in insights by improving automation, quality and documentation—and by ensuring metrics are consistently defined and reused. Your day-to-day : Build backend features for our Research Data Platform (Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL). Build & maintain dbt models (business logic, tests, docs, repo standards) to keep the data model robust for Self-Service analytics. Work closely with internal users (Research/Clinical/Business) to iterate fast and deliver value. Participate in code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of engineering standards. Support the team to deliver BI solutions such as dashboards and/or business analysis Contribute to metrics governance via a semantic layer (e.g., Cube.js) to align KPIs. Turn recurring manual work (reporting, quality triage, source onboarding) into reliable tooling, leveraging AI responsibly. ✨ Your team Your future teammates : Anna - Analytics Engineer She recently joined the team and is already growing fast on our stack and data model. She'll be your closest day-to-day teammate, and part of the deal is that the three of us level each other up. Your manager : Jean-Baptiste - Analytics Lead “We'll work together closely: my role is to find technical solutions with the Product and Platform engineering teams to answer data-related business problems, and I stay a hands-on contributor — you won't be alone in the code. I value relationships built on honesty and trust, and I really enjoy working with curious people who are always eager to learn and to help. I'm based in Biarritz and have a lot of fun doing triathlon” Team’s extra : A small team of three, with direct exposure to product, research and clinical questions. Regular team time in Biarritz — seminars, team meetings, surfing, hiking and every possible Basque country cliché. 👤 What we are looking for ⚙️ You are the right person if you can : Ship production-grade Python (tests, code quality, reviews, CI). Build and maintain backend APIs (FastAPI/Flask/Django or equivalent). Data modeling with advanced SQL to deliver production dbt models. Use AI tools as a multiplier while keeping strong engineering ownership. Deploy and operate what you build (containers, environments, CI/CD). Implement data tests/alerting and troubleshoot data quality issues. 🙂 You are the right person if you have : A structured, detail-oriented approach and a bias for automation. Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical partners. Pragmatism: prioritizing impact and maintainability. Ownership, autonomy and accountability. Curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset. Clear communication and a solution-oriented attitude. 📃 You are the right person if you have already : ~3–5 years across data and software (typical path: analytics engineer moving toward software). Worked in a maintained codebase (Git workflow, PRs, CI). Shipped production dbt models with documentation and tests. Contributed to self-service data tooling and enablement. Collaborated with product/engineering teams on data topics. Operated in a context with high standards (security, compliance, sensitive data). It’s a plus if you : Have experience with semantic layers / metrics governance (Cube.js, LookML, dbt Semantic Layer…). Have exposure to healthcare data or other GDPR-heavy environments. Have supported scientific users (Jupyter, RStudio, study data). 💛 Why join us? A mission that holds up: improving patient care with data. Rare scope at the intersection of backend and modern data engineering. A culture focused on automation and continuous improvement, with practical AI usage. Remote-friendly setup and an environment that values quality, standards and ownership. Hiring process Screening - Talent Acquisition Specialist (15 min): validate motivation and role prerequisites Manager Fit - Jean-Baptiste Pajot (45 min) : position fit, and an honest conversation about the engineering-first, hybrid nature of the role Technical Case Study - prep (max 2h) + live discussion (1h30): you'll review a small realistic case mixing analytics engineering and software engineering Clinical Fit interview - Nicoleta (30 min): collaboration fit with Translational Research and Medical teams, since you'll help build tools for clinical and research users. Culture fit - Talent Acquisition Specialist (40 min) - assess alignment with our culture and remote ways of working Strategic Fit - Jullian Bellino (30 min) : collaboration fit, engineering standards GDPR : Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity. title: Sales Executive - Responsable Partenariats Médicaux
description: 🏨 L’entreprise Resilience Care, acteur majeur de la télésurveillance médicale et partenaire de la recherche clinique, est une société française fondée en 2021 avec une mission : mieux soigner. Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d’ePRO associées à des techniques d’IA. Elles s’appuient sur une plateforme de suivi pour les professionnels de santé, permettant une détection précoce des effets secondaires pour une prise en charge continue et anticipée, et une application mobile pour les patients, permettant de mesurer et gérer leurs symptômes grâce à des ressources adaptées. Nos solutions permettent d’optimiser les prises en charge, d’enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d’accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l’analyse fine des données de vie réelle. Elles sont aujourd'hui déployées en routine auprès de 35 000 patients, dans plus de 200 établissements de santé, mais également dans le cadre d’une vingtaine d’études cliniques académiques et industrielles. Nous mettons ainsi la donnée au service du soin et de l’innovation thérapeutique avec l’ambition de permettre à chaque patient de bénéficier d’une médecine personnalisée. 📝 Ton rôle En quelques mots : tu pilotes le développement commercial et l’adoption clinique initiale de notre solution sur ton secteur. Sur un modèle 60% chasse / 40% farming , tu pars à la conquête de nouveaux établissements, tu crées le premier lien médical et tu travailles en binôme avec un·e Key Account Manager (KAM) pour maximiser l’ARR de la région. Nous recherchons actuellement des pépites expertes sur l'un de nos aires thérapeutiques : oncologie, gastroenterologie ou psychiatrie. Ton impact : tu fais grandir Resilience sur le terrain, en transformant des opportunités en signatures, puis en déclenchant l’usage médical et en réengageant des comptes à risque (baisse d’engagement / churn), avec un impact direct sur l’ARR. Ton quotidien : Cartographier les établissements (KOLs, décideurs) et mener une prospection terrain intensive. Conduire des cycles de vente B2B santé (top-down + bottom-up) jusqu’au closing. Porter une stratégie d’influence (présence aux congrès, relation KOLs, études en vie réelle). Assurer l’onboarding médical initial après signature, avant relais du KAM sur le run. Intervenir de manière ciblée sur alerte (baisse d’engagement médical) et mener des campagnes “coup de poing” de réengagement / re-conquête. title: Software Engineer - Database
description: About MotherDuck Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck , we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans. What you will do The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next. Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built. This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe. Key Responsibilities: Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud. Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances. Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end. Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals. Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation. Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most. Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems. Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team. Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next. What you bring You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like. You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.) A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques. Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at. You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems. You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies. You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs. You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment. You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs. What we provide The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases. Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success. Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond. A good pension plan Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong. Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day. description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
description: Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog. Wat jij doet Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders. In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen. Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren. Wat doe je nog meer? Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets. Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen. Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback. Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie. Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties. Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities. Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen. Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders Dit krijg je Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op: Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën? Dit breng je mee Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel: Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling. Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré. Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development. Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure. Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric Hier starten jouw kansen Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners. We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands. Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd. title: Projectontwikkelaar vastgoed
description: Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid. Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling. Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. · Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie; · Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's; · Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders; · Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken; · Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering; · Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming; · Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces; · Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie; · Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. Dit breng jij mee · Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie; · Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; · Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen; · Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).; · Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten; · Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken; · Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie. Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical. title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods. Assignment The assignment will include the following tasks: A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated. A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet. Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts. Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification. Results The final outcomes of this assignment will be: § A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case. § An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm. § A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work. Duration For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months. Profile You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master. You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus. You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn. You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice. What we offer A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support An internship allowance Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team Internship results to be used in the current and future projects About NLR Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department. Interested? Submit your application via the NLR portal, together with your (i) Motivation letter and (ii) CV and we will contact you as soon as possible.
