title: Director, Advisory and Risk Consulting
description: We are now seeking an experienced, commercially minded resilience management expert who can help clients anticipate, withstand and recover from complex disruptions while also building trusted, long-term client relationships. As the Director you will combine deep expertise in resilience, crisis, business continuity and risk management with the ability to manage existing accounts, and identify new opportunities to sell, originate and grow work in the German market. This role requires an individual with strong social skills, executive presence, a “refuse to lose” attitude, and the confidence to advise boards and senior executives, present ideas in a compelling way and translate complex thinking into clear, persuasive and structured client communications. Business Development Proactively manage accounts, identify prospects, build senior client relationships and generate new business opportunities for Control Risks, with a primary focus on corporate and government accounts throughout Germany. Work closely with your advisory & risk consulting team, account managers, Service Line leaders and the Managing Director in a consultative sales capacity, entering client conversations as a subject matter expert, shaping opportunities and helping to close new work. Own and deepen relationships with new and existing clients, demonstrating commercial persistence, high social intelligence and a “refuse to lose” approach to winning and retaining work. Own and manage a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with clear accountability for converting opportunities into profitable work. Develop targeted account plans by identifying the right accounts for Control Risks, prioritising growth accounts of relevant size and potential, mapping decision-makers and buyer groups, and pursuing cross-selling opportunities across service lines. Author thought leadership on relevant topics, present at industry and network events, and help build both the Control Risks and personal brands. Client Delivery Advise clients on complex resilience management, security, crisis, business continuity and enterprise risk challenges, developing practical, sustainable approaches that can be understood and acted on by senior decision-makers. Act as a senior project manager and trusted client adviser for Control Risks’ resilience and risk consulting projects, including assessing, designing, implementing and improving corporate security, resilience and risk management programmes, acting as the primary client contact and managing multidisciplinary delivery teams. Provide clients with expert support and insights on risk strategy, organizational structures, Enterprise Risk, Business Continuity, Crisis, Security, Cyber Risk, Digital Risk or Intelligence Management. Engage credibly with boards, executive committees and senior leadership teams, ensuring that business priorities are reflected in resilience and risk solutions and that recommendations are presented clearly, confidently and persuasively. Collaboratively scope complex and multidimensional resilience projects with clients, using strong relationship-building and social skills to bring in diverse Control Risks teams and position the firm effectively for follow-on work Own the full client delivery lifecycle from diagnostic assessment and solution design through implementation, stakeholder management, quality assurance and executive-level presentation of outcomes. Use delivery work to identify client priorities, unmet needs and follow-on opportunities. Manage engagement resourcing, budgets, margins and invoicing. Requirements Essential Significant work experience in a consulting firm. Direct, hands-on experience in selling and scoping consulting projects, including personally leading sales conversations, shaping client needs into project opportunities and converting those opportunities into won work Established network in the relevant industry and market, with a degree of external recognition or profile that enables credible senior-level client engagement and supports business development. Knowledge of best practices in resilience management, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity, organisational structures and executive decision-making under pressure. Demonstrated expertise in resilience management, including risk and resilience programme development, security and crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience optimisation. Strong understanding of cyber and digital risks and how they intersect with resilience management, crisis preparedness, business continuity and senior-level risk decision-making. Knowledge of data-driven approaches and understanding the impact of AI on resilience Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, including presenting complex recommendations in a compelling and commercially relevant way. Strong presentation skills, with the ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively. Business-level proficiency in German and English language. Preferred Experience in multiple industries and client operating environments Ability to travel 50+% of the time and on short notice Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including strong social skills and the ability to build trust quickly with senior clients and internal stakeholders. Ownership, accountability and commercial resilience to drive success both within the team and across Control Risks. The ability to multi-task and balance competing requirements, including client-facing, business development related, and internal matters Committed, enthusiastic and commercially driven, with a “refuse to lose” attitude and a proactive approach to winning client confidence and new work. A high level of integrity, loyalty and discretion Willingness to learn and develop new skills Executive presence, board-level confidence and the ability to present ideas and recommendations in a compelling, visually clear and persuasive way. Benefits Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer. We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance. Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working. As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us and are fully committed to equal treatment, free from discrimination, of all candidates throughout our recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made in order to participate fully in the interview process, please let us know and we will be happy to accommodate your needs. title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, Authorization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.</p> <p>Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.</p> <p>You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service</li> <li value="2">Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.</li> <li value="2">Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.</li> <li value="3">Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.</li> <li value="4">Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.</li> <li value="5">Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.</li> <li value="6">Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.</li> <li value="7">Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so proposed changes have a documented rationale and review feedback is addressed asynchronously.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Solid experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, typically gained over 2 to 4 years or more.</li> <li value="2">Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.</li> <li value="3">A security mindset: you treat a permission bug as a security bug and consider who a change could affect before choosing an implementation.</li> <li value="4">Experience making careful changes to existing codebases, including incremental refactors and feature-flagged rollouts that preserve existing behavior.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.</li> <li value="6">Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.</li> <li value="7">Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.</li> <li value="8">Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome transferable experience from adjacent domains such as identity, policy engines, and platform security.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We work in a fully asynchronous organization, with most decisions made in documents or merge requests rather than meetings.</p> <p>GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our values include collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency. We expect all GitLab team members to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Technology and Operational Risk Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework (IAF) and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p> <strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the second line subject matter expert for operational risk, technology (ICT and security risk (including cyber)), and operational resilience.</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging the design and effectiveness of controls over key technology systems, digital infrastructure.</li> <li>Providing effective oversight and challenge of first line risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), incident management and reporting, issue remediation and risk mitigation processes.</li> <li>Providing second line input into our technology and security strategies and business continuity planning.</li> <li>Supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of our Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, standards and associated ICT,  Security and Resilience policies and risk appetite metrics.</li> <li>Co-ordinating second line assurance reviews and risk deep dives into critical operational and technology areas, providing actionable recommendations and insights.</li> <li>Overseeing ongoing compliance with  the digital operational resilience act (DORA) in the EU and ensuring alignment  with applicable local regulatory standards.</li> <li>Preparing operational and technology risk reports and providing updates to relevant governance forums, including risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles in financial services, ideally within a digital or challenger bank, or a pan-European firm. </li> <li>You have a deep knowledge of risk management practices, regulatory expectations, and industry standards related to operational risk, technology and operational resilience. (e.g. EBA Guidelines on ICT & Security Risk Management, DORA, Central Bank of Ireland Guidance on Operational Resilience, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Payment Service Directive (PSD2/PSD3)).</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of digital banking technology, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, fintech integrations and data management.</li> <li>You have experience in evaluating and challenging risk and control environments, particularly in high-growth or fast-changing environments.</li> <li>You are an ambitious risk professional ready to leave the constraints of legacy firms behind. This role places you at the cutting edge of technology and operational risk, challenging you to define the governance needed for our next-generation platforms.</li> <li>You have strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills.</li> <li>You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes such as working with regulators/managing regulatory engagements.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €92,000 - €116,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with Monzo Bank Europe's CRO</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Territory Account Executive, UAE - Startups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Dubai, UAE</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our <strong>Digital Natives</strong> team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.</p> <p><strong>Regional Focus: UAE - Startups</strong></p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Fluency in English (written and spoken). Russian is a plus.</strong></li> <li><strong>5+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.</li> <li><strong>Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient</strong>, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms</strong> (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree required</strong>, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel</strong> <strong>up to 50%</strong> to engage with key customers and internal teams.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy

title: Product Owner / Business Analyst / AMOA (H/F)
description: E-Finances développe et commercialise des logiciels de gestion financière utilisées par des entreprises en France et à l'international depuis 25 ans. Nos outils couvrent la gestion de trésorerie, les rapprochements bancaires et comptables, ainsi que la validation et la transmission sécurisée des paiements vers les banques (EBICS, SWIFT). Nous cherchons un(e) Product Owner, Business Analyst ou AMOA pour prendre en charge le backlog fonctionnel de nos produits. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe R&D de quatre développeurs et vous êtes rattaché(e) au responsable R&D. Ce que vous ferez Organiser le backlog produit, proposer les priorités et le tenir à jour. Qualifier les demandes et les anomalies remontées par le support et les clients, et proposer la suite à donner. Rédiger des tickets clairs et complets (user stories, critères d'acceptation), prêts à être développés. Écrire et tenir à jour les spécifications fonctionnelles et les règles métier. Suivre l'évolution des normes bancaires et leur impact sur nos produits. Animer les rituels agiles : daily, refinement, sprint planning, revue de sprint et rétrospective. Préparer et réaliser les recettes fonctionnelles (tests manuels), puis coordonner les mises en production avec la R&D. Documenter le paramétrage, en lien avec le support, et contribuer aux notes de version. Contribuer à la feuille de route fonctionnelle des produits, avec le responsable R&D. Vous êtes seul(e) sur ce rôle, mais pas isolé(e) : vous démarrez sur le produit principal, avec l'appui du responsable R&D et de collègues qui connaissent très bien les produits et les clients, puis vous élargissez progressivement votre périmètre. Votre profil Idéalement vous disposez d’expérience en gestion financière, incluant par exemple la gestion de trésorerie ou la comptabilité. Vous avez aussi : un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, à l'écrit comme à l'oral l'envie de questionner les demandes et de proposer des solutions utiles aux clients de la rigueur : vous vérifiez avant d'affirmer de la curiosité pour le fonctionnement d'un logiciel : droits, données, paramétrage une expérience en recette ou en test la pratique de Jira et Confluence l'habitude d'utiliser des outils d'IA au quotidien l'anglais écrit, nos produits et leur documentation existent aussi en anglais Pourquoi nous rejoindre Des produits concrets, utilisés chaque jour par nos clients, dans un domaine exigeant (réglementation, sécurité). Un rôle où vous avez la main sur l'organisation du backlog et de la documentation produit. Une autonomie croissante dans les décisions fonctionnelles et la priorisation, à mesure que vous maîtrisez les produits. Une équipe à taille humaine, avec des échanges directs avec la direction, la R&D, le consulting et le support. Le processus de recrutement Quatre étapes : Un premier échange d'environ 30 minutes avec le responsable R&D & IT et le responsable consulting. Une étude de cas sur place, d'environ 1h30. Une rencontre avec l'équipe. Un dernier échange avec la direction. Infos pratiques Contrat : CDI, statut cadre. Lieu : Carquefou, en périphérie de Nantes. Une proximité géographique (moins d'une heure de trajet) est nécessaire pour venir régulièrement sur site. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Idealerweise Zusatzqualifikationen wie VEFK (Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft) oder im Brandschutz. title: AI Native - Project Delivery Lead
description: Quick answer: what is this job? PALO IT is hiring an AI Native Project Delivery Lead in Paris, France (hybrid) to own end-to-end project delivery from pre-sales engagement to final handover. The role requires at least 8 years of experience leading software delivery in agile, iterative contexts, strong client-facing leadership, and comfort embedding PALO IT's Gen-e²™ AI-first delivery practices into everyday project governance. About PALO IT At PALO IT , we don’t just build software, we invent the AI-first future of enterprises. As a global technology consultancy, our patented Gen-e²™ methodology puts AI at the core of everything we do, transforming how businesses design, deliver, and evolve digital solutions. We are a diverse collective of 450+ AI-native professionals across 11 offices , united by our commitment to excellence, integrity, and positive impact. Proudly independent since 2009, we combine agility and global reach, pioneering the “agentic organization” model we implement for our clients. What does an AI Native Project Delivery Lead do at PALO IT? As an AI Native Project Delivery Lead within PALO IT in Paris, you own end-to-end project delivery, from pre-sales engagement through to final handover, driving AI-augmented innovation and seamless execution at every phase. Your responsibilities include: Ensure project transparency. Share clear KPIs with teams and clients to track progress and anticipate risks. Lead project advancement. Maintain a clear view on requirements and milestones; unblock teams proactively. Guarantee service quality. Support PALO IT Labs teams, relay client feedback, and facilitate resolution of blockers. Be a trusted advisor for clients. Build strong, strategic partnerships aligned with their business goals. Partner with account management. Oversee financial performance (P&L) to secure sustainable project success. Facilitate cross-stakeholder communication. Serve as the central contact for senior client stakeholders, internal teams, and commercial leadership. Drive key reporting and governance. Document and share progress, risks, and decisions effectively. Host collaborative workshops. Create alignment on objectives and working methods anchored in Gen-e²™. Coach and uplift your Gen-e²™ delivery team. Promote continuous improvement, embed Gen-e²™ practices, and lead ceremonies (plannings, reviews, retrospectives). Advise clients on product management. Help define vision, optimize backlogs, and maximize delivered value. What experience do you need for this role? You're a strong fit for this AI Native Project Delivery Lead role if you have: At least 8 years of experience driving software delivery in agile and iterative contexts from discovery to maintenance as a natural leader. Excellent direction-setting and communication skills organizing teams and aligning objectives to boost efficiency and project outcomes. A deep understanding of clients' strategic and business context , enabling you to anticipate needs and adopt their point of view. Strong facilitation and dialogue skills , confidently engaging senior decision-makers and fostering smooth interaction across all stakeholders. Servant leadership practice situational awareness, conflict resolution, empowerment, and transparency in team dynamics. Comfort stepping into Scrum Master and/or Product Owner roles when needed. Ideally, a passion for Tech for Good (B Corp values) , including accessibility, sustainability, and ethical AI. Fluency in French and English ; additional languages are a plus. PALO IT values diverse profiles and encourages you to apply even if you don't check every box, especially if you: Share your expertise at conferences or in Software Craftsmanship communities. Contribute to open source projects. Are passionate about eco-design, social challenges, and sustainable innovation. Engage in associations or meetups focused on humanity and the environment. What we offer A playground matching your expertise missions chosen for their complexity, engineering excellence, and meaningful business and societal impact. Dedicated career coaching regular development check-ins and goal support. A demanding yet supportive technical community code reviews, pair programming, mentoring to raise development craft daily. Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week 1, fully integrated onboarding. Funded Microsoft, Anthropic and GitHub certifications. From idea to impact internal R&D labs, default open source culture, tech conferences, and innovation dojos to experiment and share. …Plus: 🌍 Global career opportunities with cross-sector and multi-country missions, connecting 11 offices worldwide. 🏠 Remote-friendly arrangements depending on project needs, alternating client sites and the Paris République office for team collaboration. 🌱 Impact Academy — training on climate, digital responsibility, and accessibility embedded in everyday practices. 🤝 Solidarity engagements — team volunteering, skills sponsorship, and more. 🥗🩺 Benefits including Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance. Frequently asked questions about this role Is the AI Native Project Delivery Lead role remote or on-site? The role is hybrid, based in Paris, France, alternating between client sites and PALO IT's Wagram office depending on project needs. How many years of experience are required for this role? At least 8 years of experience driving software delivery in agile and iterative contexts, from discovery through maintenance. What does an AI Native Project Delivery Lead own at PALO IT? End-to-end project delivery from pre-sales engagement to final handover including client relationship management, P&L oversight with account management, governance and reporting, and coaching the Gen-e²™ delivery team. Do I need to be a Scrum Master or Product Owner to apply? Not necessarily, but you should be comfortable stepping into either role when a project needs it. What is Gen-e²™? Gen-e²™ is PALO IT's patented AI-first methodology, which puts AI at the core of how the company designs, delivers, and evolves digital solutions for clients. What makes PALO IT different from other technology consultancies? PALO IT has been independent since 2009, employs 450+ AI-native professionals across 10 countries and 11 offices, is a certified B Corporation, and is pioneering the "agentic organization" model, the same model it implements for its clients. What benefits come with this role? Dedicated career coaching, funded Microsoft and GitHub certifications, a Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week one, global mobility across 11 offices, remote-friendly arrangements, the Impact Academy, skills-based volunteering, plus Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance. Diversity, equity and inclusion At PALO IT, diversity isn't just a value, it's our innovation engine. As a certified B Corp, PALO IT ensures equal opportunity and assesses candidates solely on skills, potential, and motivation. PALO IT welcomes and celebrates all identities and backgrounds without discrimination. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Full-stack Software Engineer
description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed Context You'll join a small, high-ownership engineering team building production systems that serve millions of users. We care deeply about code quality and clean architecture — and we intend to keep it that way as we scale. Your Mission Your goal is to build and ship the product that powers Lemrock's commerce infrastructure — with full ownership, from design to production. Concretely, you will: Ship features end-to-end that reach millions of users — from data model and API design to the interface they interact with. Scale and harden our backend as traffic, integrations, and product complexity grow. Shape the architecture of the codebase — enforce clean boundaries, maintain modularity, and make decisions that compound as the team scales. Move fast across the stack — backend, frontend, infra, data — wherever the highest-impact work is on any given week. Candidate Profile Strong academic background, proven professional track record, or hands-on entrepreneurial experience 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience Deep proficiency in TypeScript Experience with structured backend architectures (DDD, hexagonal, or similar) Has owned features end-to-end: data model → API → frontend → deployment Comfortable with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments — ex-founders or entrepreneurial mindsets are a strong fit Professional proficiency in French & English Tech Stack Core (required) TypeScript, NestJS, React PostgreSQL, Redis Docker Clean architecture patterns (hexagonal, ports & adapters) Bonus (appreciated but not required) GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), Terraform Vector databases, embeddings, LLM integrations Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS TanStack (Router, Query, Table), shadcn/ui, Tailwind, Vite Durable workflows (Inngest, Temporal) Why Join Us Join a company in early breakout mode , already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth Work directly with an experienced team : two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG) Be part of the next structural shift of the web — agentic interfaces Own mission-critical topics , grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory Package Competitive salary + equity, disclosed during the interview process. title: Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d)
description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role We are seeking an experienced Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d) at Black Semiconductor to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, modification, and commissioning of semiconductor manufacturing facility infrastructure. title: Senior Imaging Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&utm_source=job-ad&utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p> </p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We’re hiring a Senior Imaging Engineer to join our optics and imaging team. You’ll own key parts of the image quality across our multi-camera systems, ensuring our cameras automatically capture high-performance footage that powers computer vision, tracking and insights for teams around the world.</p> <p>As a Senior Imaging Engineer, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Evaluate and improve camera systems.</strong> You’ll measure, analyze and improve how optics, sensors and image signal processing (ISP) perform across our computer vision applications.</li> <li><strong>Test and qualify hardware.</strong> You’ll evaluate lenses and camera modules against optical and environmental specifications, run qualification tests and partner closely with external suppliers on technical follow-up, and refine optical test methods for both lab environments and production lines</li> <li><strong>Support ISP tuning.</strong> You’ll tune exposure, white balance, tone mapping and dynamic range, while contributing to camera control and 3A algorithms to enhance downstream computer vision.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate and lead.</strong> You’ll contribute to imaging requirements and trade-offs alongside product managers and our optics lead, own projects end-to-end and share knowledge to mentor fellow engineers.</li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Proven imaging experience.</strong> You have deep experience in imaging, camera systems or optical engineering, ideally working on shipped hardware products, bringing a strong understanding of optics, image sensors and ISP pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on lab expertise.</strong> You bring practical experience measuring image quality - including MTF/SFR, noise, color and distortion - using lab equipment like collimators, test charts and climate chambers.</li> <li><strong>Proficient programmer.</strong> You’re comfortable using Python for analysis and tooling, as well as C/C++ on embedded Linux.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator.</strong> You explain technical trade-offs to non-specialists with ease and make sound decisions even when working with incomplete data</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Control algorithm development.</strong> Experience developing camera control algorithms such as auto exposure and auto white balance.</li> <li><strong>Calibration knowledge.</strong> Experience with camera calibration (intrinsics, extrinsics and distortion models) and multi-camera or stitched systems.</li> <li><strong>Supplier collaboration.</strong> Experience partnering with suppliers and manufacturing partners on specifications, sample evaluations and issue resolution.</li> <li><strong>Embedded platform experience.</strong> Familiarity with embedded camera platforms and ISP tuning tools.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong>. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  </li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong>. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth. </strong>We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong>. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing. </strong>Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. </p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. </p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€60.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€101.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Team Lead Sales B2C (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Jetzt bauen wir unser nächstes Kernprodukt auf: Klimaanlagen . Greenfield . Enpals nächste Marktführerschaft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unseren Inside-Sales-Vertrieb from scratch aufbaut und führt. Deine Aufgaben Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du bist die erste Sales-Führungskraft der neuen Unit. Du startest mit 3 bis 5 Sales Managern und skalierst das Team auf 8 bis 12 und prägst es dabei mit deinen Prozessen, deinem Leitfaden und deiner Handschrift. Das Recruiting verantwortest du gemeinsam mit Talent Acquisition, vom Anforderungsprofil bis zur Einstellungsentscheidung. Sales Playbook: Du entwickelst unseren Sales-Leitfaden für Klimaanlagen, von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Einwandbehandlung bis zum Closing, und optimierst ihn kontinuierlich auf Basis von Daten und Gesprächsanalysen. Prozesse, Tools & Markt: Du führst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Produkt und Operations CRM, Tools, Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Planung und Installation weiter. Dabei beobachtest du Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Impulse für Angebot, Pricing und Verkaufsstrategie. Ramp-up & Coaching: Du onboardest neue Sales Manager strukturiert und bringst sie schnell auf Ziel-Performance. Dafür nutzt du einen klaren Einarbeitungsplan, Shadowing, Zertifizierung und definierte Ramp-up-KPIs. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework. The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team. Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. Principal Accountabilities Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations.  Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers.  Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays.  Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned.  Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure.  Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards.  Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified.  Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans.  Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach.  Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner.  Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting.  Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules.  Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives. Personal Attributes & Experience Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery.  Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms.  A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.  Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses.  Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience.  Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team.  Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services.  Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys.  Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.
