title: Software Engineer, Delivery : Release
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>The Software Delivery Section, part of the Infrastructure Platforms Department, is dedicated to enhancing the safety, reliability, and overall customer experience of GitLab’s complete software delivery process. We aim to provide seamless and efficient delivery of GitLab products across all platforms, including SaaS multi-tenant, self-managed, and SaaS single-tenant environments. Our primary goals are to accelerate delivery cycles, minimize incidents, and ensure high-quality releases that consistently meet and exceed customer expectations. By focusing on these objectives, we aim to improve GitLab’s end-to-end software delivery process, making it more reliable, efficient, and aligned with the needs of our users.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Backend Engineers with the Software Delivery:Release bring not only a strong background in backend development but also a solid understanding of, or keen interest in, infrastructure and operations. In this role, you will work alongside Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to enhance release management tooling, infrastructure, and processes. While SREs approach these responsibilities from an operational standpoint, Backend Engineers provide a software development perspective, collaborating closely to deliver efficient and safe solutions for streamlined code delivery across various supported environments. This role is ideal for individuals with a strong coding background who are also comfortable working on infrastructure, automation and operations-related topics or are motivated to develop expertise in these areas.</p> <ul> <li>Guarantee the<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/releases/"> GitLab Release Process</a></li> <li>Create new tools and frameworks to automate the release process</li> <li>Build new GitLab release features to replace existing custom tooling by contributing to <a href="https://theseus.gitlab.net/platform/components/release-framework/">new work for our Release Framework</a> </li> <li>Work with individual teams on defining and implementing solutions that will help them release quicker</li> <li>Create frameworks that allow engineers to write code that scales with demand</li> <li>Help teams instrument their code and helps recognize parts of code that could benefit from increased observability</li> <li>Work closely with peer Infrastructure Platforms groups to control the impact of application code running in user facing products</li> <li>Help communicate the release schedule clearly with others</li> <li>Develop monitoring and alerting to measure release process velocity</li> <li>Identify process bottlenecks and introduce optimizations</li> <li>Participate in <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/deployments-and-releases/#release-managers">Release Manager</a> rotation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <p>As an ideal candidate, you will have </p> <ul> <li>Strong coding background. Mandatory Ruby or Go (willing to learn Ruby is a must). Proficiency with Ruby is a strong plus. <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/job-families/engineering/backend-engineer/#professional-experience">Ruby on Rails</a> knowledge is not mandatory</li> <li>Experience working on large-scale systems</li> <li>Experience optimizing Continuous Delivery and Continuous Deployment pipelines as well as the tooling and processes that go with them</li> <li>Interest in cloud platforms, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools</li> <li>Application and systems observability background</li> <li>Collaboration mindset, boundless curiosity and a demonstrable ability to learn</li> <li>A product development mindset when developing new components</li> </ul> <p> You share our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/values/"> values</a>, and work in accordance with those values.</p> <p><strong>Performance indicators</strong></p> <p>The Delivery team has the following performance indicators:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/performance-indicators/#mean-time-to-production-mttp">Mean Time to Production</a> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Territory Account Executive, Philippines
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Singapore</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of commercial accounts in the <strong>Philippines market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.  </li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines</strong></li> <li><strong>Sales experience in cities outside of Manila (e.g. Antipolo, Cebu, Davao, Batangas) is a plus</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What is The Role</strong></h3> <p>The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.</p> <p>Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.</li> <li>Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.</li> <li>Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.</li> <li>Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.</li> <li>Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.</li> <li>Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.</li> <li>Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.</li> <li>A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.</li> <li>Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.</li> <li>Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.</li> <li>Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.</li> <li>Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 🌱 Our People Team At Joko, we believe that our people are our strongest asset, and the People Team is one of the core pillars of the company. We span Talent Acquisition, People Operations, People Business Partnering, and Workplace, and we work hand in hand with every team to make Joko efficient, scalable, and a place people genuinely love working at. We don't just run people processes — we design, challenge, and rethink them. Today, Joko is 100+ people across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, and we are set to grow to 200+ within 18 months. That kind of growth only holds up if the office, the rituals, and the daily fabric of the company scale with it — which is where the Workplace Manager comes in. 🎯 What you will do As Workplace Manager, your mission is to make Joko a place people genuinely love coming to every day, and to hold our culture together as we double in size. You will report to the VP People and partner closely with the rest of the People team, Finance, and Legal. Own the Paris office end-to-end: Our Paris office is your canvas. You will manage service providers, supplies, and facilities, keep the space impeccable and organized, and be the first point of contact for anything office-related. You will also be the go-to resource for our remote teammates across France and abroad, so the experience of working at Joko feels consistent regardless of where people sit. Bring the team together through events: From All Hands to Joko Academies, Team Events, Joko Drinks, offsites, and our legendary Christmas Party, you will design and run each gathering so it is not just well-organized, but a genuine moment of connection. As we grow into an international company, you will make sure our rituals scale with us and keep bringing the team together across geographies. Own onboarding end-to-end: First impressions matter, and onboarding is one of the most consequential parts of the Joko experience. You will run the process from employment contract to IT setup to team introductions to custom Joko goodies, so every new hire lands seamlessly and feels welcome from day one. Hold the culture as we scale: Doubling in size is precisely when a company culture can slip. The office you run, the events you design, and the way new joiners are welcomed are where Joko's culture gets rebuilt every day. You will be one of the people who keeps Joko Joko as we grow. Keep admin and compliance airtight: You will track expenses, make sure invoices are recorded correctly for our accounting team, and partner with Finance and Legal on our compliance routines so nothing falls through the cracks. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: You have 3+ years in Workplace, Office Management, People Operations, Event Management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. You have already owned an office and a set of team rituals end-to-end — you know what it takes to make them impeccable, not just functional. Ownership mindset: You take full ownership of your scope, from strategy down to the smallest detail, and run complex projects from start to finish with little supervision. Attention to detail: You spot what others miss. A crooked frame, a missing supply, a rough onboarding email — none of it gets past you, because you know these details are what people actually feel. Organized and efficient: You are structured, calm under pressure, and excellent at juggling many priorities without dropping any of them. You care about deadlines and you meet them. Interpersonal skills: You build strong relationships across the team and foster a real sense of belonging. People feel comfortable coming to you, and you make them feel taken care of. Confident communicator: You are comfortable engaging with the team every day and speaking in front of large groups when the moment calls for it. Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You welcome feedback, you go the extra mile by default, and you are not afraid of taking initiative on topics that were not in your job description. Location: Based in Paris. Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language). 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here ! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h1><strong style="font-size: 14px;">An overview of this role</strong></h1> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.</p> <p>You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.</li> <li>Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.</li> <li>Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.</li> <li>Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.</li> <li>Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.</li> <li>Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.</li> <li>Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.</li> <li>Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.</li> <li>Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.</li> <li>Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or  Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.</li> <li>Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers.</li> <li>The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward.</li> <li>Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.</li> <li>Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.</p> <p>We work with clear goals and shared priorities. You'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Senior Software Engineer, Systems Integration
description: Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence. What you'll do Design and build reliable, deterministic interfaces and drivers, from drafting the first interface control document (ICDs), to testing with state-of-the-art HITL simulators. Own the validation logic between the planning software and the hardware. Build diagnostics and secure software-update paths for deployed equipment. Build SITL emulators for the hardware you integrate, so the simulation team and CI can test against them. Lead the software side of qualification. Write the verification plan, build requirements traceability from requirement to test to result, and make sure every release ships with its test evidence and a controlled configuration. Own the software assurance pipeline in CI/CD: reproducible builds, secure boot and OS hardening, code signing, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and static analysis. Use AI coding agents as normal engineering tools: to draft tests, interface code and emulators, to check traceability links, and to prepare evidence. You decide where they are used and how their output is reviewed. Engineers own and sign the evidence. Who you are A software engineer with 5+ years' experience integrating software with hardware in aerospace, defence, rail, automotive, medical or another regulated field. Strong modern C++. Rust is welcome. Python for test automation and tooling. Hands-on with hardware interfaces and protocols: Ethernet (UDP/TCP), serial, and fieldbuses such as CAN, plus time synchronisation (PTP, GNSS time). You have taken software through a formal verification or qualification campaign: requirements-based testing, traceability, and configuration and change control. Comfortable with HITL testing; debugging across the hardware/software boundary. Able to explain technical risk clearly to systems and safety engineers, and to customers and assessors. You use AI agents in your own work, and you have clear views on where they help and where they don't. What we offer A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Cdi - Responsable Chef De Produit Chaine Et Trame Femme (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE RÔLE Le/la Responsable Chef de produit Chaîne & Trame Femme est en charge du développement des catégories C&T, Denim et Cuir. Il/Elle est en lien avec la direction créative et assure le développement des collections dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais. Le poste combine une forte implication opérationnelle sur le développement produit ainsi que le management de 2 chefs de produit et d’une alternante. VOS MISSIONS Produit : piloter le développement des modèles chaîne & trame femme (incl. denim et cuir) du brief à la normalisation. Assurer la mise au point des produits (du 1er prototype au SMS) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et la cohérence produit. Sécuriser la faisabilité industrielle tout en proposant des ajustements adaptés. Coûts : contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations si nécessaire. Suivi & coordination : piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien avec les différents intervenants (studio, tissus et fournitures, merchandising, atelier et production), et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information. Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des différents jalons de développement. Management : encadrer 3 ressources, organiser les priorités, accompagner le suivi des développements et garantir la bonne tenue du périmètre. VOTRE PROFIL Solide expérience en développement chaîne & trame femme, incluant denim et cuir. Excellente compréhension des process industriels, de la mise au point produit et des exigences qualité. Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément dans un environnement créatif et exigeant. Rigueur, sens du détail, autonomie et forte capacité d’adaptation. Aisance dans la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Première expérience réussie en encadrement ou forte appétence pour le management. Le poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role Focused Energy’s Software Department builds the internal applications, data workflows, system integrations and automation that help our scientists, finance, legal, people and executive teams work faster and more reliably. As a Software Engineer in our forward deployed model, you will join projects where Focused Energy has an important technical or operational need, understand the context, build and deliver a reliable solution, complete a clean handover, and then move on to the next priority. You will quickly learn several project domains across fusion systems, finance, legal and executive work, and you will own moderately complex features from design to deployment. You will be a go-to engineer for turning cross-functional needs into maintainable software, raising the standard for internal tools, and helping us reuse shared platforms and patterns. You will see your work directly shape how fusion research and company operations run. You will gain broad exposure to scientific, hardware, operational and business problems, and you will take ownership from day one. What You'll Do Own moderately complex, well-scoped features from technical design through testing, deployment and handover. Work directly with scientists, the people team, legal, operations, IT and other specialists to understand their goals and turn them into practical software. Build internal applications, data workflows, system integrations, APIs, automation and engineering tools based on each project’s needs. Add automated tests, logging, metrics, error handling and basic operational guidance to the software you deliver. Move between projects after delivering agreed outcomes, leaving software tested, documented, maintainable and ready for its long-term owner. Improve code quality, remove small areas of technical debt, contribute to code reviews, and reuse shared platforms and patterns where they fit. Learn several project domains quickly, deliver your first end-to-end features, and establish a reliable routine for testing, documentation and handover. Take on broader and less clearly defined projects, help standardize how internal software is built, secured and operated, and become a trusted partner for teams across the company. Who You Are You can independently own well-scoped work, with support available for broader architecture or highly unclear decisions. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including readable code, data structures, debugging, automated testing, version control and code review, with evidence of delivered working software. Ability to build and maintain software in a modern typed language such as TypeScript or JavaScript. Strong experience with a similar language is also relevant. Experience building web applications with a component-based frontend framework such as React, Vue or Angular. Understanding of relational databases and SQL, including schemas, migrations, permissions and data modeling. Experience integrating software through REST APIs, events, scheduled jobs or similar communication patterns. Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access and secure data handling. Familiarity with CI/CD, package management, basic infrastructure configuration and automated build, test and deployment workflows. Ability to use tests, logs, metrics and traces to find problems and confirm that software works as expected. Ability to use AI-assisted development tools responsibly for learning, prototyping, testing, documentation and delivery, reviewing output to the same quality and security standard as other work. Ability to learn new languages, frameworks, systems and technical domains, and a willingness to move between projects after completing agreed work. Ability to turn the needs of non-software specialists into clear technical requirements and to explain software decisions in simple language. Clear communication: you raise risks and blockers early, make realistic commitments, and take full ownership of handover, leaving no undocumented code. Understanding of maintainability, documentation, security, access control and operational readiness. Nice-to-haves Experience with TypeScript, React, SQL, PostgreSQL, serverless functions or Azure services. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including serverless or managed application platforms. Experience working in a monorepo or with shared packages, reusable components and common engineering tooling. Experience with database security, row-level permissions, identity providers, single sign-on or role-based access control. Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD systems, cloud observability or secure secret management. Experience building internal tools, technical dashboards, data pipelines, search systems, automation or third-party service integrations. Experience working with scientists, hardware engineers, research teams, industrial systems or other technical domain experts. Experience supporting a project through handover, production use or transfer to a long-term owner. Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, used without lowering review, testing, security or maintainability standards. title: Credit Manager (H/F)
description: Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé. Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions. Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout. Votre mission Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier. Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision. Ce que vous ferez Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir. Traiter les litiges à la racine avec nos équipes Opérations, Planning et Expérience Client. Animer le comité de crédit hebdomadaire : comptes à bloquer, à débloquer, conditions de paiement. Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance. Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours. Faire progresser le dispositif avec l’agent IA, et former nos commerciaux au réflexe « se faire payer ». Votre profil 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services. Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme. Les bases juridiques du recouvrement et des procédures collectives. De la rigueur, de la ténacité, et l’habitude d’un logiciel comptable (Pennylane idéalement) et d’un tableur. L’envie de travailler avec des outils d’IA et de les pousser plus loin. Ce que nous proposons Un CDI à Paris 15e. 40 000 à 45 000 € brut par an selon l’expérience, plus 5 000 € de variable sur objectifs. Un impact visible dès le premier mois : chaque jour de délai gagné, c’est du cash pour financer la croissance du groupe. Des outils qui vous libèrent du travail répétitif. description: About surge aero At surge aero, we're a growing aerospace and defence technology company developing high-performance propulsion systems and advanced unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). We're a team of curious, ambitious and hands-on people working on technology that pushes boundaries and makes a real impact in the aerospace and defence industry. Based in Germany, we bring together people from different backgrounds who enjoy building things, solving problems, sharing ideas and getting things done. We value initiative, teamwork and a practical, can-do attitude. We're growing and always excited to welcome new people who want to be part of the journey. It's a great opportunity to join an international-minded team, work on challenging technology and help shape what comes next. Come join us and be part of building the future of aerospace and defence! About the Role We are looking for a motivated and hands-on IT Assistant to support our daily IT operations at our Heimstetten office. In this role, you will provide first-level IT support to employees, assist with hardware and software management, and ensure that our workplace technology runs smoothly. You will work closely with the internal team to support onboarding, troubleshooting, and general IT administration. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a practical interest in IT, strong problem-solving skills, and a service-oriented mindset. Key Responsibilities IT Support & Troubleshooting Provide first-level IT support to employees for hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, peripherals, and basic network issues. Assist employees with Microsoft 365 applications, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint. Escalate complex technical issues to external IT providers or senior IT personnel when necessary. Hardware & Equipment Management Order, prepare and configure laptops and workstations for new employees. Install and update software, operating systems, and security tools. Manage IT equipment inventory, including laptops, monitors, accessories, and peripherals. Coordinate hardware repairs, replacements, and technical maintenance. IT Administration & Security Maintain accurate IT asset records and documentation. Support basic IT security practices, including software updates, antivirus, and device compliance. Assist with user access management and password-related issues. Help maintain an organised and efficient IT environment. Requirements Previous experience in IT support, IT administration, or a similar role is an advantage. Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365. Familiarity with computer hardware, software installation, and troubleshooting. Basic understanding of networking, Wi-Fi, and IT security. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work independently and take a hands-on approach. Good command of English; German is an advantage. Currently based in or able to commute to Heimstetten, Germany. What We Offer Part-time employment with flexible working arrangements. A hands-on role in an international and technology-driven company. Direct exposure to IT operations in an aerospace and engineering environment. A collaborative and international working environment. Opportunity to develop technical skills and grow with the company. Work Location This position is based onsite at our office in Heimstetten, Germany. Regular physical presence is required to provide direct support to employees and manage IT equipment. title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) für Wärmecontracting
description: Wer wir sind Kola NetZero bringt Eigentümer von Mehrfamilienhäusern mit einem führenden Anbieter für Wärmecontracting zusammen: Der Eigentümer bekommt eine neue, klimafreundliche Heizzentrale ohne eigene Investition, der Anbieter betreibt sie 15 Jahre lang, und wir begleiten den Weg von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Unterschrift. Hinter Kola NetZero steht die Kola Invest GmbH, ein Hamburger Family Office mit Fokus auf Wohnimmobilien. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit großem Ziel: mehrere tausend Wohneinheiten pro Monat in die Wärmewende zu bringen. Dafür bauen wir gerade das Backoffice auf, das aus eingereichten Objekten vertragsreife Projekte macht. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und prägst, wie wir arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den Weg eines Objekts vom Eingang bis zur Freigabe durch den Anbieter. Konkret: Pipeline steuern: 50 bis 100 Objekte gleichzeitig im Prozess halten. Du weißt jederzeit, welches Objekt in welcher Phase steckt, was blockiert und was als Nächstes dran ist, und berichtest das wöchentlich an die Geschäftsführung. Objekteingang prüfen: Energieausweise, Heizkostenabrechnungen, Gasrechnungen und Objektlisten der Eigentümer sichten, Daten in unsere Portfolioliste übertragen und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen. Technischen Fit bewerten: Zentral oder dezentral, Energieträger, Kesselalter, Anzahl Wohneinheiten, Warmwasserbereitung. Du entscheidest mit, welche Objekte an den Anbieter gehen und welche nicht. Vergleichsrechnungen erstellen: Kosten heute gegen Kosten mit Contracting über 15 Jahre (Brennstoff, CO2-Preis, Wartung, Investition) mit unseren Tools aufbereiten und dem Eigentümer erklären können. Beteiligte koordinieren: Eigentümer, Hausverwaltung, Messdienst, Vertrieb und Technik des Anbieters und unsere Vermittlungspartner. Du holst fehlende Unterlagen ein, hältst Fristen nach und vermittelst, wenn es hakt. Übergabe an den Anbieter: Objekte in das gemeinsame Portfolio-Sheet einstellen, Status pflegen, Begehungen koordinieren und den Vertragsprozess bis zur Unterschrift treiben. Partner-Netzwerk abrechnen: Vermittelte Objekte den Partnern zuordnen und Provisionen vorbereiten. Prozesse und Tools aufbauen: Du definierst, wann ein Objekt „vollständig“ und wann es „vertragsreif“ ist, schreibst die Abläufe auf und automatisierst mit Google Sheets, Drive und KI-gestützten Auswertungen, was heute Handarbeit ist. Dein Profil Erfahrung 3 bis 7 Jahre in einer Rolle, in der du viele Vorgänge parallel koordiniert hast, zum Beispiel: Projektleitung oder Projektassistenz bei einem Heizungsbauer, Energieversorger, Messdienst oder Contracting-Anbieter Objektmanagement oder Teamleitung in einer größeren Hausverwaltung Operations oder Customer Success in einem PropTech- oder Energie-Startup Projektsteuerung bei Sanierungen und Modernisierungen im Wohnungsbestand Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, zum Beispiel Immobilienkaufmann/-frau, Versorgungstechnik, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft. Projektmanagement Du hältst 80 Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer liegen bleibt, und entscheidest selbst, was Vorrang hat. Du kannst mit Eigentümern, Hausverwaltungen und Technikern gleichermaßen reden und hakst freundlich nach, auch zum dritten Mal wegen derselben Abrechnung. Du definierst Übergabepunkte und Fristen, hältst sie nach und kannst jederzeit sagen, wo die Pipeline steht. Fachlich Du kannst einen Energieausweis und eine Heizkostenabrechnung lesen und weißt, was eine Gasetagenheizung von einer Zentralheizung unterscheidet. Du verstehst, wie eine Hausverwaltung arbeitet, was eine WEG ist und wer beim Eigentümer entscheidet. Du rechnest gern, prüfst Zahlen auf Plausibilität und kannst eine Vergleichsrechnung erklären. Arbeitsweise und Tools Sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets, idealerweise hast du schon ein CRM oder Ticketsystem betrieben. Du schreibst Prozesse selbst auf und verbesserst sie, statt sie nur abzuarbeiten. Offen für KI-Tools im Alltag, weil ein großer Teil der Dokumentenauswertung darüber läuft. Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Pluspunkte: Kenntnisse im GEG oder CO2KostAufG, Erfahrung mit Wärmecontracting oder Energieberatung, Aufbau eines Backoffice von null. Was wir nicht suchen: Reine Sachbearbeitung ohne Koordinationserfahrung, oder Konzern-PMO mit Projekten, die 200 Tage Vorlauf haben. Bei uns sind die Projekte klein, viele und schnell. Was wir bieten Eine Rolle mit direktem Einfluss: Jedes Objekt, das du vertragsreif machst, ersetzt eine alte Gas- oder Ölheizung. Aufbauarbeit statt Verwaltung: Du definierst die Prozesse, die später ein Team von 4 bis 5 Leuten nutzt, und wächst mit in die Leitung von Operations. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Geschäftsführern und mit dem Team unseres Contracting-Partners. Festgehalt plus Beteiligung am Erfolg, abhängig von den vermittelten Wohneinheiten. Hybrides Arbeiten, Büro in Hamburg Moderne Tools: Google Workspace, KI-gestützte Auswertung von Unterlagen, keine Papierakten. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description: <h2>About the Role </h2> <p>Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.</p> <p><em>The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.</em></p> <h2>What You'll Own </h2> <p><strong> Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.</li> <li>Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.</li> <li>Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.</li> <li>Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experimentation & Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy & Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.</li> <li>Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.</li> <li>Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.</li> <li>Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring </h2> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.</li> <li>Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.</li> <li>Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical & Analytical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
description: <h3>Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology</h3> <hr> <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).</p> <p>This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.</p> <h2><strong>Key objectives include:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.</li> <li>Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.</li> <li>Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.</li> <li>Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.</li> </ul> <p>The overarching goal is to create systems that enable <strong>transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge</strong>, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.</p> <hr> <h3>Applicant Profile</h3> <h2>Mandatory requirements:</h2> <ul> <li>Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related title: Ph.D. Position in Computer Science (Wearable Intelligence & Data Fusion)
description: <p>Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology</p> <p><strong>About the Position</strong></p> <p>The research group of <a href="https://sari-saba-sadiya.github.io/">Dr. Sari Sadiya</a> at <strong>Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL)</strong>, in collaboration with <strong>Constructor University (CU)</strong> and <strong>Constructor Technology (CT)</strong>, invites applicants for <strong>Ph.D. student positions</strong> in Computer Science with a focus on <strong>wearable intelligence, multimodal data fusion, and edge AI</strong>.</p> <p>The project investigates how wearable data streams can be transformed into structured knowledge and integrated into a knowledge-grounded digital avatar that supports bi-directional collaboration in education and research.</p> <p>Ph.D. students will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment, combining <strong>AI/ML, edge computing, cognitive science, and human–computer interaction</strong>. In close collaboration with academia and industry, they will contribute to building <strong>privacy-preserving, real-time personalization frameworks</strong> while pursuing their doctoral dissertation.</p> <p><strong>About the Program</strong></p> <p>The PhD program is research-centered, emphasizing original contributions in:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Wearable data analytics and fusion methods</strong></li> <li><strong>Biomedical data analytics</strong></li> <li><strong>On-device processing and performance modeling</strong></li> <li><strong>Personalization and adaptive reasoning systems</strong></li> <li><strong>AI for Education</strong></li> </ul> <p>Doctoral students will also have access to specialized courses in:</p> <ul> <li>Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Edge Computing</li> <li>Advanced Computational Methods and Data Science</li> <li>Cognitive Science and Human-Centered Computing</li> </ul> <p>As part of the program, students will collaborate with <strong>Constructor Technology</strong> to gain first-hand industrial experience, contributing to real-world testbeds and prototypes.</p> <p><strong>Research Focus</strong></p> <p>This PhD position is part of the <strong>Wearable Intelligence Project</strong>, with two main research directions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Data fusion of heterogeneous temporal streams</strong></li> <ul> <li>Designing algorithms to unify multimodal signals (physiological, cognitive, contextual, scheduling, and learning data).</li> <li>Developing pipelines that produce structured insights powering the <strong>Agentic Personalization Engine (APE)</strong>.</li> </ul> <li><strong>On-device data processing & performance modeling</strong></li> <ul> <li>Developing models balancing computation, energy, and data flows across wearable, edge, and cloud environments.</li> <li>Exploring feasibility of running <strong>compact micro-LLMs directly on wearables</strong>.</li> </ul> </ul> <p>The overarching goal is to create <strong>scalable, ethical, and transparent personalization systems</strong> that support education and research.</p> <p><strong>Funding </strong></p> <p>The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:</p> <ul> <li>Monthly stipend of €1,650</li> <li>Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)</li> <li>Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month</li> <li>Supplementary €603 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)</li> </ul> <p>Constructor Knowledge Labs actively supports candidates in preparing applications for external funding — doctoral scholarships, foundations, or international mobility grants — and can provide institutional support and references</p>
