disciplines.</li> <li>Strong background in AI/ML, signal processing, or edge computing.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with <strong>wearable or multimodal data (e.g., heart rate, EEG, activity, sleep, GPS)</strong>.</li> <li>Solid mathematical and computational modeling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in academic English writing (e.g., reports, papers, theses).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with <strong>LLMs, multimodal data fusion, or agent-based AI systems</strong>.</li> <li>Familiarity with <strong>privacy-preserving ML, dynamic consent, and GDPR-compliant frameworks</strong>.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and collaborate across disciplines.</li> <li>Interest in teaching, mentoring, and applied industrial research.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Details</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Deadline</strong>: August 31, 2026</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required documents:</strong></p> <ul> title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: About Apaleo and the role Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why. At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews. This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew. What you'll be up to Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped. Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem. Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis. Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer. Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture. Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones. Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next. Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers. Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it. Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows. Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. What you'll bring You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction. Required experience and competencies Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do. Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role. Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions. Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value. Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform. Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence. An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions. Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction. Nice to have Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations. Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems. Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience. Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work. Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life. Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschlandticket. Team connection. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. Joining Apaleo Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible. Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Operations Director-Based in Munich/Berlin
description: About Us Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles. We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel. The Role As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President. You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model. You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers. What You Will Work On Leadership and performance Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law. Customer first Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close P&L and cost ownership Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region Collaboration and growth Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time) Who We Are Looking For Must have Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education) 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country. You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one. You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere. You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate. You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse. You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies. You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip. You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours. You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest. You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not. You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters. Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction. Nice to have Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated. A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product. Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere. Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one. A third language used in your region The Indie Commitment A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila Continuous training and coaching Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania Are you ready to Go Indie? title: Global Investigator (EMEA)
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close. The impact you will have: Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline. Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream. Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations. Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline. What we’re looking for: 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis. Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown. Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter. Strong written and verbal communication. About the Team: The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors. Team Operating Rhythms: Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone. Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage. On-Call Responsibilities: Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters. Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events. Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Austin, TX</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Data Center Design Engineer to design Cloudflare’s pending and future infrastructure deployments for generational improvement in cost, quality, and speed of deployment. range of global partner vendors.  </p> <h3>What you'll do:</h3> <p>Translate data center capacity requirements into actionable white space design and/or rack plans within individual data center contract constraints for power, coolingManage implementation phase of cage projects with data center providersDesign low voltage structured cabling, fiber, cross-connect & conveyance infrastructure as Systems, Pump controls, Glycool/Glycols, AHU units (DX, split, RTU, CRAC, etc.), CRAH, Raised Floor Systems, HOT/COLD aisle containment and Building Management Systems</li> <li>Understanding of basic electrical theory (voltage, current, power), basic circuit design & analysis, and single- and three-phase power systems</li> <li>Familiarity with Data Center M&E infrastructure design concepts, Institute Tier Classifications</li> <li>Excellent verbal, written communication and presentation skills</li> <li>Experience working with multiple time zones and multiple cross-functional teams</li> title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare Hyperdrive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA (Hybrid)</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:</p> <ul> <li>Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.</li> <li>Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.</li> <li>Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.</li> <li>Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.</li> <li>The team is geographically distributed across North America.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.</li> <li>You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.</li> <li>You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. You’re familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols.</li> <li>You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware.</li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem and the unique stateful connection challenges of ephemeral computing.</li> <li>You’ve contributed to database drivers, ORMs, or low-level networking libraries.</li> <li>Experience using eBPF, perf, or other profiling tools to find and kill bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>F<span data-sheets-root="1">or Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: (Junior) Content & SEO/GEO Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Mainz oder Hamburg / Remote (Hybrid) | Vollzeit oder Teilzeit Wer wir sind Wir bei Löwenzahn Organics haben eine klare Mission: Wir denken den Markt für Babynahrung neu. Wir reden Klartext, wir enttabuisieren Themen, die sonst gerne umschifft werden, und wir schaffen radikale Transparenz. Bei uns gibt es kein Marketing-Blabla, sondern echte Fakten und ehrliche Unterstützung für Eltern. Wir sind modern, wissenschaftsbasiert und mit Leidenschaft dabei. Deine Mission Du sorgst dafür, dass Eltern uns finden, verstehen und vertrauen, und zwar nicht nur bei Google, sondern auch dort, wo heute immer mehr Menschen ihre Fragen stellen: in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity & Co. Du verbindest klassische Suchmaschinenoptimierung (SEO) mit Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte in KI-generierten Antworten zitiert und empfohlen werden. Content mit Haltung: Du schreibst Blogartikel, Ratgeber, Landingpages und Newsletter, die wirklich etwas aussagen. Du erklärst komplexe Themen wie Ernährung, Inhaltsstoffe und Entwicklung einfach, ehrlich und belegbar. SEO-Strategie: Du recherchierst Keywords, planst Content-Cluster, optimierst bestehende Seiten, analysierst technische Grundlagen gemeinsam mit dem Team und wertest die Performance über Tools wie Google Search Console und Google Analytics aus. GEO-Strategie: Du verstehst, wie Large Language Models Quellen auswählen und Inhalte zusammenfassen. Du strukturierst unsere Inhalte so, dass sie in KI-Antworten sichtbar werden: klare Antworten, saubere Struktur, Autorität, Quellenangaben und maschinenlesbare Daten. Monitoring & Messung: Du baust ein Reporting auf, das zeigt, wo wir in klassischen Suchergebnissen und in KI-Antworten stehen, und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. AI als smarter Co-Pilot: Du nutzt Tools wie Gemini, Claude, Langdock oder ChatGPT, um Recherche, Briefings und Content-Produktion zu beschleunigen, ohne Qualität und Faktentreue aus den Augen zu verlieren. Das bist du Du liebst Klartext: Du schreibst direkt, nahbar und ohne geschwollene Phrasen. Transparenz ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du kennst SEO aus der Praxis: Du hast erste Erfahrung in der Content-Erstellung und Onpage-SEO sowie ein gutes Verständnis für technisches SEO. Du verstehst GEO: Du hast dich mit der Frage beschäftigt, wie KI-Suchsysteme Inhalte auswählen, und hast erste Erfahrungen darin, Inhalte für KI-Antworten zu optimieren. Du hast ein Auge für Zahlen: Du kannst Keyword-Recherche, Ranking- und Traffic-Daten sauber auswerten und daraus Entscheidungen ableiten. Dabei weißt du SEO-Tools wie z. B. Ahrefs richtig einzusetzen. AI-Expertise: Du kennst aktuelle AI-Workflows für Text, Recherche und Bild und nutzt sie sicher, ohne SEO-Relevanz oder Qualität zu vernachlässigen. Selbstläufer: Du arbeitest eigenständig, hast Lust auf die Dynamik eines jungen, stark wachsenden, international agierenden Unternehmens und bringst deine eigenen Ideen proaktiv ein. title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
description: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! Jouw rol Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate. Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren). Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s. Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Wie zijn wij? Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/ Jouw profiel Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance) Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen Wat bieden wij jou? Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende: Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime 2 verlofdagen per maand Flexibiliteit en vrijheid Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis Laptop voor gebruik bij Heras Iets voor jou? title: Automation, IT Systems & Security Specialist (m/f/d)
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Automation, IT Systems & Security Specialist (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions. In this key role, you act as the architect and guardian of our internal IT infrastructure. Your focus is not on maintaining the status quo, but on building a highly secure, automated, and scalable system landscape. You eliminate manual effort through intelligent IT automation and ensure that our network and security architecture keeps pace with our global growth. Your Responsibilities Design and implementation of a secure, cloud-aligned IT and network landscape (e.g. AWS, Zero Trust principles) Ensuring highest standards in Identity & Access Management (IAM), SSO, and secrets management Protection of endpoints and continuous monitoring of system integrity across all teams Identification and automation of repetitive IT processes (e.g. automated onboarding/offboarding, asset management) Selection and integration of tools that connect and streamline internal workflows across Finance, HR, and Engineering Active use of modern automation tools, including AI-supported solutions, to sustainably reduce manual support effort Ownership of global device and lifecycle management, including rollout processes Acting as a technical lead for complex first- and second-level support topics Close collaboration with Engineering and Cloud teams on infrastructure, security, and automation topics We're looking for someone who has: Completed vocational training or a degree in Computer Science, IT Systems, Security or a comparable field Several years of experience in system administration, network architecture, or IT security in cloud environments Strong ownership mindset: you take responsibility, proactively identify gaps, and close them independently A strong automation mindset: you are driven by the principle of not doing things twice manually and actively use scripting or tools to improve processes Deep understanding of cloud architectures, modern identity models, and network security concepts A structured and pragmatic working style, combined with a strong ownership mindset and focus on scalable systems Very good English skills (German is a plus) Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. title: Automonteur
description: Heb jij ervaring met het onderhouden en repareren van personenauto’s? Werk je graag met moderne diagnoseapparatuur en wil je jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou als Automonteur! Via Bommel Uitzendbureau ga je aan de slag bij een professionele dealerorganisatie in Maastricht. Deze organisatie maakt deel uit van een grote Europese automotivegroep en verzorgt de verkoop en het onderhoud van personenauto’s. Je werkt in een moderne werkplaats aan personenauto’s van verschillende bekende automerken. Samen met betrokken collega’s zorg je ervoor dat klanten veilig en tevreden de weg op gaan. Als Automonteur krijg je afwisselende werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij jouw opleiding en ervaring. Wat je gaat doen · Uitvoeren van onderhoud, reparaties en technische aanpassingen aan personenauto’s; · Opsporen en verhelpen van storingen met moderne test- en diagnoseapparatuur; · Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden aan onder meer motoren en automatische versnellingsbakken; · Afleverklaar maken van nieuwe en gebruikte auto’s; · Overleggen met de diagnosetechnicus bij complexe technische problemen; · Oppakken van complexere reparaties en ondersteunen van collega’s wanneer je als eerste autotechnicus aan de slag gaat; · Uitvoeren van APK-keuringen als je hiervoor bevoegd bent. Wat wij vragen · Een afgeronde opleiding op minimaal MBO-2 niveau in de autotechniek; · Een diploma op MBO-3 niveau wanneer je als eerste autotechnicus aan de slag wilt; · Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse of Engelse taal; · Een geldig rijbewijs B; · Een nauwkeurige en zelfstandige werkhouding; · Technisch inzicht, initiatief en plezier in het oplossen van problemen; · Het vermogen om goed samen te werken met collega’s. Wat wij bieden · Een salaris van € 2.600 tot € 3.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, ervaring en eventuele APK-bevoegdheid; · Een fulltimebaan voor 40 uur per week, waarbij 32 of 36 uur bespreekbaar is; · 24 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks 64 extra verlofuren bij te kopen; · Trainingen en opleidingen via merkimporteurs en vakscholen; · De mogelijkheid om je APK-bevoegdheid te behalen; · Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting eerste autotechnicus of technisch specialist; · Een moderne werkplaats met goede gereedschappen en apparatuur; · Een zorgvuldig inwerktraject en begeleiding door ervaren collega’s; · Een goede pensioenregeling en diverse personeelsvoordelen, waaronder korting op je sportabonnement en op de aanschaf, het onderhoud en de verzekering van een auto. title: (Senior) Consultant Financial Services (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind EMPA ist eine Beratung für Data & Management Consulting mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Im Bereich Financial Services unterstützen wir Banken, Asset Manager, Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften, Depotführer und Verwahrstellen dabei, ihr Geschäft weiterzuentwickeln, Abläufe zu verbessern und neue Lösungen einzuführen. Bei uns bringst du deine Erfahrung und deine Ideen in Kundenprojekte ein. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung beim Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte zu setzen, neue Beratungsangebote zu entwickeln und unseren Financial-Services-Bereich mit aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben Als (Senior) Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden von der fachlichen Fragestellung bis zur Umsetzung. Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung arbeitest du als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer, Scrum Master oder im PMO. Perspektivisch kannst du auch als (Teil-)Projektleiter oder Product Owner Verantwortung übernehmen. Du analysierst Abläufe im Banking, Asset Management und Depotgeschäft und entwickelst Vorschläge, wie sich diese verbessern lassen. Du übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in verständliche Konzepte und konkrete Anforderungen, die du mit Fachbereichen und IT abstimmst. Du gestaltest digitale Produkte und Onboarding-Prozesse mit und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Plattformen und Schnittstellen. Du arbeitest an Daten- und KI-Vorhaben, verbesserst die Datenqualität und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, regulatorische Anforderungen in ihren Prozessen und Systemen umzusetzen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, führst Workshops durch und begleitest Tests sowie die Einführung neuer Lösungen. Du entwickelst mit uns Beratungsangebote, Methoden und Fachbeiträge und bringst dein Wissen in Kundengespräche ein. Das bringst du mit Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine entsprechende berufliche Qualifikation. Du bringst erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Banking oder Asset Management mit – aus einer Linienfunktion bei einem Finanzinstitut oder aus Beratungsprojekten für Banken, Asset Manager oder andere Finanzdienstleister. Du kennst dich in mindestens einem unserer Themenfelder aus – Depotgeschäft, Investment Operations, digitale Plattformen, Datenmanagement oder Projektsteuerung. Du hast Erfahrung im fachlichen Test, etwa bei der Erstellung von Testfällen, der Durchführung von Tests oder der Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Fehlern. Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen ein, erkennst Zusammenhänge und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären. Du arbeitest selbstständig, stimmst dich mit deinem Team ab und bringst eigene Vorschläge ein. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist bereit, abhängig vom Projekt auch vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten. Erfahrung mit Atlassian-Tools wie Jira und Confluence sowie ALM Octane ist willkommen. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Kenntnisse in BPMN, SQL oder Power BI. Wünschenswert sind Zertifizierungen in Scrum, PRINCE2, Requirements Engineering oder im Softwaretest, etwa ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) oder ISTQB Certified Tester Acceptance Testing (CT-AcT). Was wir dir bieten Anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte, in denen du Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung begleiten kannst. Die Möglichkeit, neue Beratungsangebote mitzuentwickeln und beim Ausbau unseres Financial-Services-Bereichs Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Schulungen und Weiterbildung, mit denen du dein Wissen vertiefen und neue fachliche Schwerpunkte erschließen kannst. Ein Team, das Erfahrungen teilt, gemeinsam an Lösungen arbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Eine attraktive Vergütung, die deine Erfahrung und deine Fähigkeiten berücksichtigt. Moderne Ausstattung, ein zentral gelegenes Büro in Frankfurt, regelmäßige Teamevents und eine Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft. Dein nächster Schritt Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin. Gemeinsam besprechen wir, ob der Einstieg als Consultant oder Senior Consultant zu deiner Erfahrung passt. title: Personalberater (m/w/d)
description: Dein Einkommen und deine Karriere sollten nicht an einer Gehaltsstufe enden. Du wartest schon lange auf die nächste Gehaltserhöhung? Du leistest viel, merkst es aber nicht im Gehalt? Dann könnte das hier die passende Stelle für dich sein. NonStop Consulting baut das Team in Berlin weiter aus. Wir sind gerade in größere Büroräume im Zentrum der Stadt gezogen und suchen ehrgeizige, wettbewerbsorientierte Leute, die gut verdienen und sich über ihre Ergebnisse weiterentwickeln wollen. Sprachen Die Arbeitssprache im Job ist Deutsch. Du telefonierst, verhandelst und schreibst täglich auf Deutsch mit Kunden und Kandidat:innen, daher brauchst du verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1). Zusätzlich erwarten wir gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Kommunikation, zum Beispiel mit Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften an unseren anderen Standorten. Erfahrung in der Personalberatung brauchst du nicht. Du bringst die Motivation mit, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Vergütung 35.700 € Brutto-Jahresfixgehalt plus unbegrenzte Provision 45.000 bis 65.000 € Gesamteinkommen im ersten Jahr (realistischer Richtwert für Berufseinsteiger:innen in der Personalberatung) 65.000 bis 100.000 € und mehr im zweiten Jahr Einige unserer Personalberater:innen verdienen deutlich mehr Führungspositionen sind für leistungsstarke Mitarbeitende in unter zwei Jahren möglich Die Provision ist nicht gedeckelt, dein Verdienst steigt also mit deinen Ergebnissen. Wer wir sind Wir sind eine internationale Personalberatung mit etablierter Einarbeitung und erfahrenen Führungskräften. In Berlin wachsen wir gerade und suchen nicht nur Personalberater:innen, sondern auch künftige Top-Performer, Teamleiter:innen und Manager:innen. Wer gut arbeitet, kann bei uns schnell aufsteigen. Quereinstieg ist möglich Du musst nicht aus der Personalbranche kommen. Viele Bewerber:innen kommen aus Vertrieb, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel, Immobilien oder Kundenservice. Du kannst auch frisch von der Uni oder aus der Ausbildung kommen und eine Laufbahn suchen, in der dein Gehalt nicht durch ein klassisches Einstiegsgehalt begrenzt ist. Uns interessiert vor allem deine Einstellung. Im strukturierten Onboarding und mit laufendem Coaching lernst du, Neukunden zu gewinnen und langfristige Beziehungen zu Unternehmen aufzubauen, mit Kunden und Kandidat:innen zu verhandeln und Abschlüsse zu erzielen, einen eigenen Fachmarkt und ein Kundenportfolio aufzubauen, sicher im Vertrieb aufzutreten, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen und dich für Führungsaufgaben weiterzuentwickeln. Diese kaufmännischen Fähigkeiten sind in vielen Bereichen gefragt. Das Team Bei uns geht es leistungsorientiert zu, aber die Arbeit soll trotzdem Spaß machen. Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Vertriebsumfeld mit Kolleg:innen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, Wissen teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge feiern. title: Database Engineering Intern
description: We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation. Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks. Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible Tasks Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled. Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed. Improve our data models : reduce duplicated values and work with references and views. Optimise data access so that more work happens in the database and less in the application. Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference. Review our database access policies. Requirements You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar. Comfortable in SQL : joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan. You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it. PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus. Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation . Experience with AI-assisted development tools . Humble, low ego , not afraid to get your hands dirty. Get things done mentality : prioritising results over process. Fluent in English, German is a plus. Benefits Scaling from 0 to 1 : you shape how this company works, from the processes to the team around you. Work as a full team member of an interdisciplinary team of top performers that will both support and challenge your growth. Lunch allowance , a subsidized sports membership and modern tech. We use digital twins and robotics to automate the manufacturing process, orchestrated by VetaionOS, our own operating system for the factory. Our mission is to strengthen Germany as a leading industrial hub. Join our team and our mission, let's reinvent the future of production together! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? </p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. </li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong>: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar</li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages </li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong> </strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.</p> <p>Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.</p> <p>This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.</li> <li value="2">Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.</li> <li value="3">Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.</li> <li value="4">Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.</li> <li value="5">Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.</li> <li value="6">Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.</li> <li value="7">Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.</li> <li value="2">Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.</li> <li value="3">A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.</li> <li value="4">Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.</li> <li value="5">Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.</li> <li value="6">Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.</p> <p>GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. title: Project Manager
description: About Taurus Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth. Tasks The Role We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. title: Telco Field Engineering Director
description: <p>This is an opportunity to run the worldwide Telco Field Engineering business, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. The Telco department is composed of three regional teams (APAC, EMEA and AMER). </p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.</p> <p><strong>The role of a Telco Field Engineering Director at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The Field Engineering department is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc.  The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process. </p> <p>Within the Field Engineering department, there are multiple focused teams : the Cloud/DC team, the Alliances/Partners team, the IoT team, and the Telco team. </p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>A Cloud Field Engineering Director is responsible for driving the strategy in presales and delivery for our telco customers. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role will be home based, managing teams in worldwide.</p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop managers and teams of Field engineers in the areas of Presales and Professional Services</li> <li>Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor</li> <li>Work remotely in a single major time zone</li> <li>Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback</li> and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices</li> <li>Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects</li> <li>Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc<br>Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards<br>Working knowledge of at least one of the following domains: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of Linux and networking</li> <li>Experience in technical presales</li> <li>You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English</li> <li>Passion and a track record of developing and growing people</li> <li>Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers and managers</li> <li>Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results</li> <li> An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well</li> <li> Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional skills that you might also bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Second language - Spanish or French preferred</li> <li>Python knowledge</li> <li>Experience collaborating with external partners</li> <li>Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps</li> <li>Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including sovereign AI, and their potential applications in telco environments, such as network optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li>Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide.
