title: Director of Structured Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes. Structured Finance is responsible for making sure Cloudflare has the right capital, on the right terms, to keep building one of the world’s largest networks.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Structured Finance to lead the structuring and execution of financings that support our global network and infrastructure strategy. Our infrastructure spans hundreds of cities worldwide, and as we continue to scale — including the servers, GPUs, and data center capacity that power our network, Workers AI, and our Developer Platform — how we finance that build-out is a strategic lever for the business.</p> <p>You will own financing workstreams end-to-end: structuring, counterparty engagement, term negotiation, documentation, and close. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure, Hardware Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A teams to turn infrastructure plans into investable, well-priced transactions. The role will also extend to broader capital markets and capital structure work as the company grows.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a lean team. It combines hands-on transaction execution with financial analysis, relationship building with the financing community, and strategic decision support for senior leadership and the Board. We hold a very high bar on rigor and judgment, and we are AI-native in how we work.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Infrastructure and asset financing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own financing workstreams end-to-end for Cloudflare’s network and data center infrastructure — including equipment and hardware financing, leasing, vendor financing, and other structured solutions — from structuring and counterparty engagement through term negotiation, documentation, and close.</li> <li>Translate infrastructure requirements and capex plans into clear, investable frameworks and title: Intern - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
description: Über Finton Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion. Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist. Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich. Deine Aufgaben Projektunterstützung: Du arbeitest im Hintergrund in laufenden Kundenprojekten mit: Du bereitest Finanzdaten aus ERP und Buchhaltung auf, baust Auswertungen und Dashboards auf unserer AI-Plattform und lieferst dem Projektteam die Grundlage für das Gespräch mit dem CFO. Finanzmodelle und Analysen: Du wirkst an Finanzmodellen, Cash Forecasts, Deckungsbeitragsanalysen und Unternehmensbewertungen mit und prüfst Daten und Ergebnisse auf Plausibilität. Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerber und AI-Entwicklungen im Finance-Bereich und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für unser Angebot ab. Produktentwicklung: Mit deinem Feedback aus Projektarbeit und Markt hilfst du unserem Technologie-Team, die AI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln. Eigeninitiative: Du gestaltest mit, statt nur abzuarbeiten, auch bei internen Themen wie Recruiting, Wissensaufbau oder Prozessverbesserung. Das bringst Du mit Studium: Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung mit sehr guten Leistungen, mindestens drei abgeschlossene Semester. Erfahrung: Erste relevante Praxiserfahrung, etwa durch Praktika in Consulting, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Private Equity oder in der Finanzabteilung eines Unternehmens. Handwerk: Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint, Grundverständnis von Bilanz, GuV und Cashflow; erste Berührung mit Finanzmodellen oder Bewertung ist ein Plus. Technologie: Interesse an AI und Prozessautomatisierung im Finanzwesen. Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss, aber du willst verstehen, wie unsere Lösungen funktionieren. Analytik: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis. Haltung: Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team Dinge selbst voranzutreiben. Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deine ersten Monate bei Finton In den ersten Tagen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und bekommst einen festen Ansprechpartner im Team. Schon in der ersten Woche unterstützt du ein Kundenprojekt aus dem Hintergrund: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust erste Auswertungen und siehst, wie aus Rohdaten ein Reporting für den CFO wird. Nach den ersten Wochen übernimmst du eigene Arbeitspakete, etwa einen Teil eines Finanzmodells, eine Wettbewerbsanalyse oder den Aufbau einer neuen Lead-Liste, und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse direkt den Gründern. Benefits Echte Aufgaben statt Zuschauen: Du arbeitest an realen Projekten, Modellen und Strategiethemen mit und siehst, was mit deiner Arbeit beim Kunden passiert. Kein Kaffeekochen, kein Folienschubsen ohne Kontext. Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: Du bekommst einen festen Mentor aus dem Gründerteam, regelmäßiges Feedback und Einblick, wie eine Beratung aufgebaut und geführt wird. Perspektive: Wer überzeugt, hat die Option, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen. Vergütung: Eine faire Praktikumsvergütung, die deine Erfahrung berücksichtigt. Technologie: Du arbeitest mit unserer eigenen AI-Plattform statt mit Excel-Handarbeit und lernst, wie Finance- und Beratungsarbeit in den nächsten Jahren aussehen wird. Standort Köln: Unser Büro liegt am Friesenplatz, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort, weil du so am schnellsten lernst und wir als kleines Team schnell entscheiden wollen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören dazu. Ausstattung und Extras: Firmenlaptop, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Fitnessabo, kostenlose Getränke im Büro, lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien. title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
description: Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale. Role Overview This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs. You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number. The role is deliberately hands on . You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you. Why this role is exciting You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck. You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness. You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically. You’ll work directly with the Group CFO , with fast decisions and no corporate red tape. Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval. You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on , high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast. What we expect from you Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact. Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps. Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line. Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream. Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting. Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n. Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build. Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out. Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard. What we look for You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing. A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit. Strong understanding of finance processes , ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes. Hands on with AI . You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you. You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips. You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself. You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect. You bring finance, tech and operations along with you. Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage. What’s in it for you Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly. Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work. Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust. Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact. Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one. Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria. Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz . Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card . A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together. If this sounds like you… You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us? Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Eigenschaften wie selbstständiges Arbeiten, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber Neuem solltest du dabei auf jeden Fall mitbringen. Zusätzlich sind folgende Punkte für die Stelle relevant: Du bist eingeschriebener Student und kannst mindestens 15 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten Du hast Lust auf strukturierte, verlässliche Arbeit mit klarer Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft Du kommunizierst sauber, freundlich und professionell, auch wenn es schnell gehen muss Du arbeitest sorgfältig und dir ist Genauigkeit wichtig Du kannst unterhalb der Woche deine Arbeitszeit flexibel auf mehrere Tage verteilen Benefits Warum wir kein normaler Arbeitgeber sind. Wir vertrauen den Menschen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder gemäß seinen individuellen Stärken und Schwächen weiterentwickeln kann. title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
description: Responsibilities With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead. Responsibilities: Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics. Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring. Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand. Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales. Build the Data Foundation : Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role. Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome. Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership. Skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics). Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production. Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark). Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow). Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other. Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation. A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking. What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together. title: Intermediate Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.</p> <p>You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.</li> <li>Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests.</li> <li>Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.</li> <li>Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.</li> <li>Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.</li> <li>Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake is preferred.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ELT or extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines at scale, including incremental loads, schema changes, backfills, and API ingestion.</li> <li>Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, familiarity with dbt, and solid data modeling fundamentals, including Kimball dimensional modeling.</li> <li>Experience running and troubleshooting data infrastructure, with comfort using Git-based workflows, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and code review.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, with an understanding of where they help and where they fall short.</li> <li>Clear written communication, the ability to use GitLab, and comfort working asynchronously in a fully remote organization in line with GitLab's values.</li> <li>Preferred, not required: experience with Snowflake; Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Terraform; SaaS application APIs such as Salesforce, Zuora, or Zendesk; data observability tooling; or Snowflake administration.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Data Platform team within Enterprise Data is responsible for a scalable, reliable and secure data platform for data analytics at GitLab. That includes managing and maintaining the infrastructure we use, both SaaS and self-managed, and building and maintaining the data pipelines that bring data into it. We make data reliable, secure and ready for analytics, data science and AI tools. As more questions go straight to AI tools and agents, the platform underneath has to be more reliable, better governed and more cost-efficient than ever. We're fully remote and globally distributed, and work asynchronously through issues, merge requests and the handbook.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
description: <h3>About Tensordyne </h3> <p>AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?</p> <p>As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.</p> <p>You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.</p> <p>You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..</p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..</p> </li> <li> <p>Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..</p> </li> </ul> <p>Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.</p> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..</p> </li> <li> <p>Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..</p> </li> <li> <p>Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..</p> </li> <li> <p>An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <p>Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:</p> <ul> <li> <p>GPU or AI accelerator programming..</p> </li> <li> <p>Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..</p> </li> <li> <p>Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..</p> </li> <li> <p>LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Why Join Tensordyne?</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..</p> </li> <li> <p>Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..</p> </li> <li> <p>Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..</p> </li> <li> <p>Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..</p> </li> <li> <p>Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..</p> </li> <li> <p>Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.</li> <li>Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.</li> <li>Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.</li> <li>Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.</li> <li>Own it and get it done. Results matter!</li> <li>Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.</li> <li>Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.</strong></p> <p><strong>A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!</p> <h3><strong>The</strong> role</h3> <p>Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.</p> <p>The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.</p> <p>We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build the agentic workflows.</strong> Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.</li> <li><strong>Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr.</strong> Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.</li> <li><strong>Optimize numerics.</strong> Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.</li> <li><strong>Make numerical quality measurable.</strong> Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.</li> <li><strong>Ship software that lasts.</strong> Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.</li> <li><strong>Shape the next chip.</strong> Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.</li> </ul> <h3>What we need from you</h3> <ul> <li><strong>You understand LLM inference end to end.</strong> You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.</li> <li><strong>You build excellent software.</strong> You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.</li> <li><strong>You are fluent with agentic tooling.</strong> You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.</li> <li><strong>You take ownership and bring others along.</strong> You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.</li> </ul> <p>If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <h3>We’d be thrilled if you had</h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.</li> <li>Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.</li> <li>Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.</li> <li>Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.</li> </ul> <h3>Why join us</h3> <p>Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.</p> <p>If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.</p> <h3>Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values</h3> <ul> <li>Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.</li> <li>Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.</li> <li>Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.</li> <li>Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.</li> <li>Own it and get it done. Results matter!</li> <li>Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.</li> <li>Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.</strong></p> <p><strong>A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.</strong></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Vietnam
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Singapore</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of enterprise accounts in the <strong>Vietnam market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.  </li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluent in English and Vietnamese to engage with customers in Vietnam</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
description: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment entwickelst du ein wachsendes Team regionaler Account Executives weiter: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas. Unsere Vision Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden. Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln. Über uns Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen. 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft. Deine Mission Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus. In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin. Dein Team Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien. Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben. Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien. Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir. Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform. Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst. Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch: Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen Kanzleimarkt. Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um. Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals. Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert. Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig: Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen. Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess. Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen. Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest. Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein. Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call. Dein Profil Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl. Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten. Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ. Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris. Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil). Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel. 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt. 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust. 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln. 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren. 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung. 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin. Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit. Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: Business Intelligence Data Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>What is Contentstack?</strong></p> <p>Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.</p> <p>While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.</p> <p>Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.</p> <p>Learn more at <a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="http://www.contentstack.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.contentstack.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.contentstack.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Who Are We?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!</span></p></div><h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Are We Looking For?</span></h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Business Intelligence Data Architect</strong> to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.</p> <p>In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.</p> <p>If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead analytical architecture and governance:</strong> Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.</li> <li><strong>Build governed data models and semantic layers:</strong> Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li><strong>Establish analytics engineering best practices:</strong> Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Enable secure, reliable data access:</strong> Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.</li> <li><strong>Partner across the business:</strong> Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and enable the team:</strong> Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Drive platform evolution:</strong> Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Really Gets Us Excited About You</span></h2> <ul> <li>5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.</li> <li>Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.</li> <li>Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.</li> <li>Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.</li> <li>Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.</li> <li>Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.</li> <li>Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.</li> <li>Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.</li> <li>Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.</li> <li>Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.</li> <li>Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.</li> <li>Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.</li> <li>You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Do We Offer?</strong></p> <p><strong>Interesting Work |</strong> <span style="font-weight: 400;">We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. </span></p> <p><strong>Tribe Vibe </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.</span></p> <p><strong>Bragging Rights</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> |</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>One Team One Dream </strong></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">|</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">To review our Privacy Policy, please click <a href="https://www.contentstack.com/legal/privacy-notice-for-candidates/" target="_blank">here</a>.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
