revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Developer Stack Experience:</strong> Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI and AI Gateway.</li> <li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong> This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Customer Engineer, Public Sector Federal
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations: Washington, D.C.</h2> <h2>What you’ll do as a Senior Customer Engineer, Public Sector Federal</h2> <p>You are the technical lynchpin through the entire sales cycle - pre-sales and account technical leadership. You will work closely with our Public Sector prospects and customers to educate, empower, and ensure their success on the Cloudflare platform. Your technical expertise in Cloudflare’s global distributed network and technology will allow you to find best-fit solutions for prospects, to train and onboard new customers via video-conference or in person, create documentation, and to support the long-term technology strategy of the customer. </p> <p>As a Public Sector Federal Solutions Engineer, you will need to have strong technical knowledge of both on premise security and networking implementations and public cloud initiatives common to US Public Sector Federal customers. You are the technical customer advocate within Cloudflare and will work closely with every team at Cloudflare, from Sales and Product, through to Engineering and Customer Support. </p> <p><strong>What we look for in our Solutions Engineers</strong></p> <p>Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: engineering, software development, product management, customer support, and project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.</p> <p>Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. You appreciate the diversity of challenges in working with customers, and look forward to helping them realize the full promise of Cloudflare. You are an educator who works with empathy to drive positive outcomes for your customer. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>As critical members of Cloudflare’s Public Sector Sales team, Solutions Engineers drive technical discussions and implementations to help generate new business, expand existing business, and keep our customers happy.</li> <li>In business generation and expansion, you’ll be tasked with qualification of prospect and customer use cases, technical requirements discovery, leading demonstrations, solution identification and design, and collaborative work on proofs-of-concept (PoCs).</li> <li>For our existing customers, Solutions Engineers are part of a dedicated account team that advises the customer on technical best practices, implementation of Cloudflare products and features, and strategic guidance.</li> <li>The role is focused on emerging Dept. of Defense  & DISA segment within our Federal segment and as such will require some travel, Generally, the role requires 35-45%  travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrated understanding in internet technologies: OSI Model layers 1-7,Routing TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), SSL / TLS.</li> <li>Comfortable with SASE frameworks and related technologies such as Secure WEb Gateway, CASB, DLP, SD-WAN, etc.</li> <li>Comfort with on premise infrastructure and networking configurations, including potential legacy systems or methodologies.</li> <li>Minimum 4 years of experience in a customer-facing sales or consulting role supporting the US Federal Government.</li> <li>Technical curiosity and passion: Cloudflare is at the cutting edge of internet technology, and our Solutions Engineers are viewed as subject-matter experts. It’s incumbent on us to stay up to date not only with Cloudflare’s specific products, but with industry trends.</li> <li>A focus on learning, teaching, collaboration, mentorship, and growth, not only personally but also within the team and company.</li> <li>Aside from technical and collaborative skills, we place a high value on project management, relationship building, and EQ.</li> </ul> <h3>Desired</h3> <ul> <li>You're not afraid of command-line interfaces, RESTful APIs, or analyzing HTTP request and response in a browser’s web inspector.</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>Experience serving the US Department of Defense or DISA market segment</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Graduate-level degrees in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>Certifications: Azure/AWS/GCP Architect, etc.</li> </ul> <h3>More About You</h3> <ul> <li>You can translate technical concepts and jargon for a wide variety of audiences: from systems engineers, to front-end developers, through to IT managers and C-levels in enterprise organizations.</li> <li>You want to be constantly learning new things and teaching what you've learned to the broader team through internal and external blog posts, team demos, and product training sessions.</li> <li>You have a knack for understanding problems and finding creative ways to solve them. Our product suite is ever-growing, and knowing how to identify which parts will solve a customer's particular problem is important.</li> <li>You understand how to manage a project, work to deadlines, and prioritize between competing demands.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Washington based hires: Estimated annual salary of $211,000 - $257,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong><br>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion. Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. <br><br>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $214,000.00 - Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p><p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p><p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p><p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p><p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p><p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p><p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><h3>Rapid response:</h3><ul><li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li><li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li><li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li></ul><h3>Proactive engineering:</h3><ul><li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li><li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li><li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li><li><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</li><li><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</li><li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</li><li><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</li><li><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</li></ul><h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2><ul><li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li><li>Strong foundation in networking and security:<ul><li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li><li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li><li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li><li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li><li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li><li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li></ul></li><li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li><li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li><li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>チームについて</strong></h3> <p>私たちのBDR（Business Development Representative）組織のミッションは非常にシンプルです。 それは、「営業チームに高品質かつ大規模なパイプラインを供給し、Cloudflareの持続的な収益成長を牽引すること」です。</p> <p>そのために私たちは「人材・プロセス・ツール」のすべてにおいて最高水準を追求しています。とりわけ人材の育成とキャリア開発には強いこだわりを持っており、チームワークを尊重し、お互いの成功を称え合うカルチャーを大切にしています。強固なBDR組織の構築こそが、Cloudflareの市場における圧倒的な競合優位性を生み出す源泉であると信じています。</p> <h3><strong>ポジションの概要</strong></h3> <p>本ポジションでは、「ピープルマネジメント（育成・牽引）」「組織ビルディング」「戦略的思考」を兼ね備えたリーダーを募集しています。営業、インサイドセールス、またはBDR/SDR組織におけるチームマネジメントの豊富なご経験をお持ちの方を求めています。</p> <p>BDRチームの運営基盤（Sales Motion）の強化、四半期目標の安定達成、組織拡大に向けた戦略立案、そして協調的なチームカルチャーの醸成を主導していただきます。Cloudflare Japanは今後12ヶ月でさらなる変革と成長を予定しており、次代を担う優秀なリーダー・メンバーの育成と支援も非常に重要なミッションとなります。</p> <h3><strong>主な業務内容</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>BDRチームの運営基盤（オペレーション）の構築・強化</strong></li> <ul> <li>ターゲット顧客への効果的なアプローチ手法の確立、データ活用、営業支援ツール（Sales Tech）の実装、営業チームへのスムーズなリード引き継ぎプロセスの構築</li> </ul> <li><strong>他部門（営業・マーケティング・オペレーション）との強固なパートナーシップ構築</strong></li> <ul> <li><strong>営業部門：</strong> リード獲得基準（SQL定義）、案件の品質・数量に関する共通認識の形成、スムーズな商談引き継ぎの実現</li> <li><strong>マーケティング部門：</strong> MQLの質と量の最適化、各種キャンペーンの効果検証、メッセージング（訴求軸）の共同開発</li> <li><strong>オペレーション部門：</strong> レポート作成・分析、営業プロセスの継続的な改善</li> </ul> <li><strong>グローバルとの連携およびベストプラクティスの導入</strong></li> <ul> <li>他地域のBDR組織と連携し、グローバルで成功している最新のBD戦略やノウハウを積極的に日本市場へ導入・共有</li> </ul> <li><strong>メンバーのマネジメントと組織拡大</strong></li> <ul> <li>5名以上（今後さらに拡大予定）のBDRメンバーのピープルマネジメント</li> <li>BDRメンバーの積極的なリクルーティング、面接、採用活動の推進</li> </ul> </ul> <h3><strong>応募要件（Qualifications）</strong></h3> <h4><strong>【必須要件】</strong></h4> <ul> <li>BDR/SDRまたは営業（Account Executive）チームのマネジメント経験（10年以上）</li> <ul> <li>うち5年以上は、担当チームの組織拡大（スケーリング）をリードした経験</li> </ul> <li>急成長中のIT/テクノロジー企業における実務経験（5年以上）</li> <li>学士号（Bachelor's degree）または同等の実務経験</li> <li>自身およびチームにおける高い目標達成能力（個人/チームでのノルマ連続達成実績）</li> Team</strong></h3> <p>Our BDR organization's mission is simple. While building this infrastructure, the candidate will also be responsible for executing on quarterly targets, ideating on ways to scale the team, and preserving our collaborative culture.  While the role is defined today, we expect the next 12 months to bring change and new challenges including  helping to develop a growing team of extraordinary managers.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive a solid base for the operational infrastructure for the Business Development team.  This includes data syndication, building effective prospecting motions, implementing tools and technology, and driving effective handoffs with Sales.</li> <li>Develop and maintain effective partnerships with Sales, Marketing, Operations</li> <ul> <li>Sales - Mutual understanding of handoffs, qualification criteria and pipeline quality/quantity</li> <li>Marketing - Quality/Quantity of MQL’s, campaign measurement & effectiveness, messaging development</li> <li>Operations - reporting, process improvements</li> </ul> <li>Stay up to date and infuse industry best practices on effective Business Development strategies into the organization.  Collaborate internally with other regions to learn/share on what's working.  </li> <li>Managing a group of 5+ (expected to grow) Business Development professionals.  </li> <li>Recruit, interview, and hire BDRs at scale</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 10 years’ experience leading a sales team of BDRs or Account Executives, of which at least 5 years’ experience in scaling a team of reps</li> <li>More than 5 years’ professional experience working in a rapidly growing technology company</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required</li> <li>Proven track record of closing sales and exceeding quota</li> <li>Experience building career development programs for high performing individual contributors</li> <li>Experience with funnel management across multiple channels (inbound, upsell, outbound, marketing)</li> <li>Knowledge of using Salesforce and related systems (data tools, Lean Data, Sales Acceleration tools, etc.)</li> <li>Excellent project management skills</li> <li>Self-motivated and possess entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced and dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills (both verbal & written)</li> <li>Aptitude in learning technical concepts & terms</li> <li>Demonstrate excellent communication skills</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Named Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Switzerland</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p class="doc-paragraph">We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Named Account Executive to join our Swiss Sales Team, focused on the German-speaking market. You will build multi-year account plans, orchestrate virtual deal teams across Solution Engineers, Deal Desk, Legal, and Product, and position Cloudflare as a critical long-term platform partner for some of Switzerland's most strategic enterprises. You will engage at board and executive level, lead complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and consistently exceed new logo and expansion targets. Build a robust pipeline of high-value prospects through targeted executive outreach, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, and referrals. Consistently bring new logos onto the Cloudflare platform and exceed new business targets each quarter.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategic Account Planning</strong>: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for both net-new targets and existing named accounts, with clear prioritisation of new logo opportunities. Demonstrate a nuanced understanding of enterprise buying behaviour and apply it to drive net-new deals forward with precision and appropriate urgency.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding</strong>: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect's and customer's technology environment — including cloud strategy, security posture, compliance requirements, and AI and ML infrastructure. Map Cloudflare's platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, driving comprehensive platform adoption in place of point-solution sales.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Virtual Deal Team Leadership</strong>: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to manage and close complex, high-value opportunities. Proactively navigate blockers, maintain deal momentum, and ensure a consistently high-quality customer and prospect experience throughout.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution</strong>: Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to prospect research, personalised executive outreach, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Digital Transformation & AI Positioning</strong>: Serve as a knowledgeable and credible partner to customers navigating digital and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping enterprise infrastructure, compliance, and competitive dynamics — and position Cloudflare's platform capabilities, including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads, as central to your customers' strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting</strong>: Deliver highly accurate, insight-driven account-level forecasts to sales leadership. Maintain rigorous pipeline management across long and complex enterprise sales cycles, providing clear and honest visibility into deal status, risks, and required actions at all times.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure</strong>: Lead complex contract negotiations with confidence and expertise, constructing compelling outcome-linked value propositions directly tied to each customer's strategic objectives. Drive commercially strong and sustainable outcomes across new logo and expansion opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution</strong>: Share knowledge, field intelligence, and best practices openly across the team. Provide constructive guidance to colleagues, contribute to the wider organisation's understanding of the Swiss enterprise market, and serve as a leader who elevates the work of those around them.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li> <p class="doc-paragraph" style="line-height: 1.1;"><strong>6+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar new logo and quota targets in a named or strategic account model.</p> </li> <li> <p class="doc-paragraph" style="line-height: 1.1;"><strong>Proven enterprise hunter </strong>— a demonstrated track record of opening and closing large, complex net-new accounts at C-suite level, not just managing and growing existing relationships.</p> </li> <li> <p class="doc-paragraph" style="line-height: 1.1;">Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), and Edge Computing technologies, with the ability to engage credibly with senior technical buyers including CISOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p class="doc-paragraph" style="line-height: 1.1;">Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</p> </li> <li> <p class="doc-paragraph" style="line-height: 1.1;">Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles across procurement, legal, technical, and executive buying centres simultaneously.</p> </li> <li> <p class="doc-paragraph" style="line-height: 1.1;">Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context — prospect research, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as an expert and technical leader on our Agentic Commerce team. In this role, you will define the architecture, build core systems, and establish technical standards powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization across Cloudflare's network.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineer, your impact extends beyond individual features. You will shape product and engineering roadmaps by partnering directly with customers, product managers, and across Cloudflare teams. complexity for the team, ensure seamless recovery from internal and external failures, and improve overall system health observability.</li> <li>Lead complex incident responses, retrospectives, and root-cause analyses while driving initiatives that proactively prevent customer escalations and reduce system alerts.</li> <li>Debug and resolve high-complexity issues spanning multiple teams, services, and protocols, using these opportunities to teach others how to handle similar challenges.</li> <li>Actively mentor engineers, improve engineering and interviewing processes, conduct high-impact spec and code reviews, and share knowledge through technical talks and writings.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Deep software engineering and distributed systems expertise with a track record of architecting, building, and operating high-throughput, low-latency production services.</li> <li>Broad experience with HTTP, API design, payment protocols/rails, web security, and cryptographic authorization mechanisms.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience defining product KPIs and translating complex customer and product requirements into clear architectural roadmaps.</li> <li>Proven track record of debugging complex distributed system failures that span multiple teams and systems, with a focus on systemic remediation.</li> <li>Strong history of technical mentorship, leading incident retrospectives, and driving process improvements inside and outside your immediate team.</li> <li>Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate deep architectural trade-offs, and establish design patterns in an emerging technical domain.</li> <li>Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with experience drafting RFCs and specifications consumed by multiple engineering organizations.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in Rust (especially async Rust) or TypeScript/JavaScript edge wallet architectures.</li> <li>Experience architecting high-precision event metering pipelines, usage-based billing engines, outcome verification systems, or revenue attribution tools.</li> systems, agent protocols, web standards, or distributed systems projects.</li> <li>Experience training interviewers, closing candidates, or guiding company-wide technical standards.</li> </ul> </div> This work combines customer-facing product development with challenging problems in distributed systems, data modeling, state consistency, observability, and operational reliability.</p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the services behind Cloudflare for SaaS. Unix/Linux development and runtime environments.</li> <li>A track record of delivering well-tested, reliable code and taking ownership of it in production.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience designing and evolving RESTful APIs used by external customers.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including schema and query design.</li> <li>Understanding of architecture.</li> <li>Experience with observability tools and practices, including metrics, logs, tracing, alerting, and SLOs.</li> <li>Familiarity with PKI/TLS, certificate lifecycle management, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.</li> </ul> title: Senior Systems Engineer - Application Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available locations: <span class="collapsed-field-text">Lisbon, Portugal or London, UK. </span>This role requires two days in office, it is not a fully remote role.</strong></span></h2> <h2>About The Team</h2> <p>Application Security is responsible for Cloudflare’s fast-growing security product portfolio including WAF, Page Shield, Web Asset Management and API Shield. Being part of Cloudflare means working at internet scale and we are uniquely positioned to tackle challenging problems related to being connected to more networks, websites and customers than any other provider worldwide. Working at great scale by default (to an extent not offered by most other employers in big tech) means pushing boundaries well beyond what commodity solutions like Nginx and Kafka provide out of the box. You’ll be working with custom components that have been created in an engineering-driven and pragmatic way - our code is well-tested and documented and uses modern ecosystems like Go and Rust. This gives you confidence that you will spend your time having an impact and not firefighting!</p> <p>You’d be joining a high-profile part of the business that can really accelerate and support your career. Cloudflare has a strong track record of growing in a thoughtful way and hires carefully so we’re confident that you will enjoy working with your colleagues here!</p> <h2>About You</h2> <p><strong>You must have at least 5 years of professional experience working hands-on as a software developer</strong>. We require proficiency with at least one of Go or Rust, plus exposure to devops tooling like but not limited to Kubernetes, Salt, Kafka or Systemd. Strong Linux / Unix fundamentals will be very helpful. You must have experience working with distributed systems at scale. Experience with cyber security is preferred but not essential.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s culture is busy and multifaceted, and people who succeed here are persistent, have a can-do attitude and a genuine willingness to assume good faith in others. This last quality in particular requires them to be empathetic and emotionally intelligent, so you’re someone willing to take responsibility for the culture and environment that you create around you.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Design systems and write code following bleeding edge industry best practices and help others on the team do the same. Review RFCs, technical specifications and code.</li> <li>Deploy and maintain live software-based services at scale (up to 100m requests / second, 1m customers). Take regular shifts as part of the team’s On Call rota.</li> <li>Support and grow other Engineers through knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Keep up to date with trends in detecting current and emerging security risks to web applications and provide input on how these impact Cloudflare’s products.</li> <li>Work with Engineers and Product Managers outside your immediate team in communicating our roadmap and getting things done.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>Cloudflare offers a positive and stimulating place to work, where you can enjoy friendly relationships with your colleagues and the freedom to have real impact on our products and customers. While the work is demanding, the company is unusual in offering an unlimited leave policy. This is not a “race to the bottom” or proxy for reducing the amount of leave taken; leaders around the company model the behaviour of always taking the time off that they need.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base salary, Cloudflare offers an equity program with stock grants on joining and regular refreshers linked to performance. And in common with other big tech companies, we offer medical and dental insurance, mental health support, a tax efficient defined contributions pension plan and life insurance.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. pipeline and corporate infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Understanding of attacker Tools, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs)</li> <li>Understanding feeds.</li> <li><strong>Cloud Security:</strong> Familiarity with security services and automation in major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).</li> </ul> <p>Equity<br>This role is eligible to complaints at scale.</li> <li>8+ years experience managing a large team effectively with a strong desire to help others learn and grow.</li> <li>Experience working with law enforcement and legal requests for customer information.</li> <li>Deep technical experience understanding how the Internet works. </li> <li>Understanding of the Internet ecosystem and the roles and functions of the various types of online service providers. </li> <li>Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving complex and sensitive issues, often under considerable time pressure.  You must have demonstrated the with c-suite level executives.</li> <li>Significant awareness of existing and emerging approaches to law enforcement access and intermediary liability to be able to engage on such issues at a very high level. </li> <li>A global network of contacts --you can reach the right people quickly to help solve problems that you can’t solve directly. </li> <li>Experience working on international issues title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible Language: English; German a plus Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls How to apply Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does. title: Manager CTO Office
description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein. Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie. Sturing en beheersing Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten. Verandering en verbetering Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur; Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie; Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office; Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology; Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties; Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst; Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten; Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur. Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk; Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology. Wat vragen we van jou? Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren. Dit breng je minimaal mee: WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management; Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen; Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving; Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams; Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert; Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! title: Business Development Representative, CEE
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you. title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
description: PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen. Aufgaben Das bewegst du Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen. Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen. Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter. Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen. Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird. Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben. PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente. Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich. Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt. Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen. Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen. Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht. Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level. Benefits Wir bieten dir Faire Spesenregelung Förderung und Unterstützung zur Weiterentwicklung und Weiterbildung PEAX Private Abo Flache Hierarchien, agile Arbeitsweise Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice; Standort in Luzern (Hybrid) Tolles Office und Begegnungsort inmitten der Stadt Luzern Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
