title: Senior Product Designer
description: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Why a designer now We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Product Designer , you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster. You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set. Journeys and engagement Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit. Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky. Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data. Growth surfaces Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels. Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from. Craft and UI ownership You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence. During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent. Design system and enablement Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan. Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with. How you work You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision. You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision. You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign. On a typical week On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience. On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves. In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details. On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined. We offer A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution; Competitive, benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year; Pension plan; 5 Mental health days per year; Access to OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. Apply for the job Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer ? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate. P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
description: SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. title: Business Development Manager
description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte. Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen. Eigene Projekte vorantreiben: Du verantwortest Projekte wie Produktanalysen, die Bewertung von Geschäftschancen und die Entwicklung betrieblicher Mobilitätskonzepte. Du definierst nächste Schritte, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und erzielst Ergebnisse. Das Produkt verstehen: Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Verständnis unserer Plattform, der Kundeneinrichtung, Buchungen, Abrechnungen und Integrationen. So gestaltest du Lösungen mit, die wirtschaftlich und operativ funktionieren. Mit KI besser arbeiten: Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, testest neue Anwendungen und verbesserst die Qualität und Effizienz unserer Recherchen, Analysen und Prozesse. Wachstum vorantreiben: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und arbeitest mit dem Commercial-Team daran, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Partnerschaften auszubauen. Überzeugend argumentieren: Du erstellst klare Präsentationen, fundierte Business Cases, überzeugende Angebote und aussagekräftige Kundenreviews, die den Mehrwert unserer Lösungen sichtbar machen. Für Fortschritt sorgen: Du setzt klare Prioritäten und hältst Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte in HubSpot aktuell. Du hältst Zusagen ein und gehst Hindernisse frühzeitig an. Teams verbinden: Du klärst technische und kommerzielle Fragen gemeinsam mit Product, Operations und Technology und leitest daraus verständliche Empfehlungen für Kunden und das Team ab. Den Status quo hinterfragen: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial, hinterfragst Annahmen und machst aus kreativen Ideen konkrete Verbesserungen. Was du mitbringst Einen sehr guten akademischen Leistungsausweis, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Data Science oder Ingenieurwissenschaften. Wissbegierde, Kreativität und nachweisbare Leistungen sind uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Studienrichtung. Relevante praktische Erfahrung im Business Development, in der Beratung, in einem Technologieunternehmen oder im unternehmerischen Umfeld. Du kannst zeigen, welche Projekte du verantwortet und welche Ergebnisse du erzielt hast. Analytisches Denkvermögen, einen sicheren Umgang mit Excel und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen und Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und klar und einfach zu erklären. Grosses Interesse an der Mobilität der nächsten Generation und an den Technologien, Geschäftsmodellen und Verhaltensänderungen, die die Branche prägen. Idealerweise kennst du die betriebliche Mobilitätslandschaft bereits und hast Ideen, wie sie sich verbessern lässt. Gutes Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst Zielkonflikte abwägen, Wesentliches priorisieren und vorankommen, ohne auf vollständige Informationen zu warten. Tatkraft und einen kreativen Zugang zur Problemlösung. Du entwickelst Vorschläge, überprüfst Annahmen und findest Wege, Dinge voranzubringen. Technologieaffinität und praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Copilot sowie das Urteilsvermögen, deren Ergebnisse kritisch zu prüfen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Französisch ist ein grosser Vorteil. Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Haltung. Du bringst Begeisterung, Ehrgeiz und eine lösungsorientierte Einstellung mit. Du lernst schnell, stellst durchdachte Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse. Du achtest auf Details und suchst laufend nach Wegen, gute Arbeit noch besser zu machen. Du bist selbstbewusst genug, eine Idee zu hinterfragen, und offen genug, deine Meinung zu ändern. value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="6">Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.</li> <li value="7">Partner title: Intern Power Electronics Engineer
description: With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. As an intern within our Traction Power Systems R&D team, you will support the development and validation of power electronic converters and control solutions used in railway and industrial applications. You will work alongside experienced engineers on innovative projects involving power conversion, control algorithms, testing, and system analysis. The internship has the duration of 6 months and is expected to start in January 2027, but if that is not the best for you, let us know your availability. Key responsibilities Support the design and analysis of power electronic converters. Assist in the development and validation of control algorithms. Participate in laboratory testing, measurements, and troubleshooting activities. Analyze simulation and test results and prepare technical reports. Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation projects within the team. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. Strong interest in power converters, control systems, and electrical energy conversion. Basic knowledge of power electronics and control theory. Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar is an advantage. Curious, autonomous, and eager to learn in a hands-on engineering environment. Good communication skills in English. Benefits A challenging internship in an international engineering environment. Exposure to real-world power electronics and railway technology projects. Mentorship from experienced R&D engineers. Opportunity to develop practical skills in power conversion and control systems. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Ingénieur MES (h/f)
description: Contexte Dans le cadre de projets de transformation digitale au sein d’un groupe international du secteur des sciences de la vie, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement pour accompagner l’évolution et le déploiement de solutions informatiques industrielles sur plusieurs sites en Europe. Vous interviendrez sur la qualification d’une solution MES (Manufacturing Execution System), destinée à soutenir et à optimiser les processus de production, tout en garantissant sa conformité aux exigences qualité et réglementaires du secteur. Votre rôle et missions Votre rôle En tant qu’Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la qualification du système et l’accompagnement de son déploiement sur différents sites européens. Vous veillerez à la fiabilité, à la conformité et à la bonne intégration de la solution dans les environnements industriels concernés. À l’interface entre les équipes IT, les équipes de production, les interlocuteurs qualité et les équipes projet, vous contribuerez à sécuriser les différentes étapes du cycle de vie de la solution, de la préparation des activités de qualification jusqu’à sa mise en service opérationnelle. 🎯 Missions 🔹 Qualification & validation du système MES * Participer à la définition et à l’exécution de la stratégie de qualification et de validation du logiciel MES. * Rédiger, revoir et exécuter les protocoles de tests et la documentation de validation. * Préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, les tests d’intégration et les tests de non-régression. * Identifier, documenter et suivre les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution. 🔹 Déploiement international * Participer au déploiement de la solution MES sur plusieurs sites en Europe. * Accompagner les équipes locales dans la préparation, l’exécution et la validation des activités de déploiement. * Contribuer à l’adaptation de la solution aux spécificités opérationnelles des différents sites, dans le respect des standards définis. 🔹 Documentation & conformité * Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique et qualité liée aux activités de qualification. * Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de qualification et de déploiement. 🔹 Collaboration & support * Collaborer avec les équipes IT, qualité, production et métiers afin de garantir une compréhension commune des besoins. Votre profil : Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes industriels, automatisation, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent. Expérience en qualification logicielle, validation des systèmes informatisés ou validation de solutions MES. Bonne compréhension des environnements industriels réglementés, idéalement dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou des sciences de la vie. Connaissance des méthodologies de validation et des bonnes pratiques documentaires. Expérience dans la rédaction et l’exécution de protocoles de tests, ainsi que dans la gestion des anomalies. Une expérience dans le déploiement de solutions sur plusieurs sites constitue un atout important. Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques, qualité et métiers dans un environnement international. Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, indispensable pour évoluer dans un contexte international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements ponctuels sur les différents sites européens, selon les besoins du projet. 🏆 Conditions du poste * 📍 Localisation : Suisse romande * 🕒 Taux d’occupation : 100 % * 💼 Type de contrat : Mission de consulting * 📅 Démarrage : Flexible / Janvier 2027 * 🌍 Environnement : International et multisite * ✈️ Déplacements : Possibles en Europe selon les besoins du projet Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Jouw impact bij Movares Help mee om perrons slimmer, duurzamer en toekomstbestendig te maken voor reizend Nederland. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules. Dit krijg je bij Movares Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook: bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat; lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s. Jouw team bij Movares Voor jou als afstudeerstagiair(e) Constructieve Perrons is er plek op onze afdeling Integraal Ontwerpen in team W-installaties. Binnen dit team werken collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden samen aan duurzame en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor het spoor. Je komt terecht in een open en betrokken werkomgeving waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Tijdens jouw afstudeerstage werk je nauw samen met specialisten op het gebied van constructies, geotechniek en dynamica. Ook heb je contact met ProRail en leveranciers. De sfeer is inhoudelijk sterk, maar tegelijkertijd laagdrempelig. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig onderzoek uit te voeren, ideeën te toetsen en jouw resultaten te bespreken met ervaren collega's. title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
description: Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing. Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE. Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen. We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt. YOU Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau; Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels; Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn; Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief; Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen; Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt). OUR OFFER Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie; Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever; Een inspirerende werkomgeving; Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent; De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen; De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers; Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback; Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand; Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie. KEUNE We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter. description: 24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship. Dit ga je doen Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door: Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies. Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen. Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken. Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk. Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties. Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa. Quote "De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega's Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen. Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Dit neem je mee Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Dit bieden we jou Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. Daarnaast bieden we: Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime. Een laptop. Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden. Stageplusprogramma Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. title: Commercial Account Executive, UK
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. Role Description Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s UK growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular UK travel, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our UK Commercial team. We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week. What You’ll Do Grow Horizon3.ai’s UK Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions. Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the UK market. Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter. Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities. Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes. Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention. Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood. Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience. What You’ll Bring At least 5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas. Previous experience selling technical solutions into the UK market. Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential. Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management. The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person. Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC). Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach , LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack. The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Fluency in English; additional language skills are welcomed. Travel Required We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager. Perks of Horizon3.ai Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. You Belong Here Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai , every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai , where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Application Note In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data Scientist Marketing
description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right. That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days. Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher. Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces. You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost. You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed. You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running. You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention. You use AI tools like Claude Code in your daily work and know where they stop. You are fluent in English. Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up. Your space to perform We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪 🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset 👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly. 🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration 🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office. 📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget 🧘 €60 monthly allowance via Alleo by Epassi, rolling over monthly and resetting annually 🚌 Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳) 💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us 🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options 💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq 💸 Monthly contribution to your phone and internet bills 🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen. Wij vragen HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Environment Automation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.</p> <p>In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. </p> <p>Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.</p> <p>Some examples of the projects you could work on:</p> <ul> <li>Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes</li> <li>Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab</li> <li>Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)</li> <li>Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants</li> <li>Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale</li> <li>Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response</li> <li>Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)</li> <li>Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure:</strong> Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Debug & Resolve Production Issues: </strong>Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.</li> <li><strong>Automate Operations at Scale: </strong>Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.</li> <li><strong>Monitor & Predict Capacity: </strong>Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.</li> <li><strong>Respond & Lead During Incidents: </strong>Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Collaborate: </strong>Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Production-Scale Experience: </strong>Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.<br><strong>Terraform & IaC Mastery:</strong> Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.<br><strong>Kubernetes in Production: </strong>Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.<br><strong>Programming & Code Analysis: </strong>Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.<br><strong>Large Scale Operations Background: </strong>Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.<br><strong>Architecture & Incident Response:</strong> Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.<br><strong>Customer-Focused Collaboration: </strong>Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication.<br><strong>GitLab Platform Proficiency: </strong>Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>GitLab’s Dedicated team, where the SRE Environment Automation role sits, is on a mission to deliver a fully managed, single-tenant GitLab experience through the GitLab Dedicated platform. Our goal is to eliminate manual operations across the entire lifecycle of customer environments, including provisioning, upgrades, security, and monitoring, so customers can focus on unlocking the full potential of The One DevOps Platform without managing the underlying infrastructure. We build scalable, automated systems that ensure each GitLab Dedicated instance is secure, consistent, and production-ready—whether we're managing 10 environments or hundreds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Desired Experience You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Exa is an equal opportunity employer. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. What we're looking for You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system. Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats. Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance. Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++). You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers Example projects Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely. Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency. Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well. Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result. Logistics Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich. Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion. You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers. What you will own Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations. Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development. Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors. Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close. Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability. Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control. Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership. Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists. Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land. Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth. Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy. What success looks like First 30 days Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references. Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources. Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory. Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration. First 90 days Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions. Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays. Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives. Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities. Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development. First 180 days and beyond Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market. Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages. Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes. Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners. Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands. Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential. What you will bring Must-haves 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end. Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements. A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts. Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately. Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes. A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working. Nice-to-haves Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology. Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners. Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements. Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation. Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction. Why this role matters now Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation. This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands. You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation. Role Summary: As our Enterprise Sales Executive, you will be instrumental in shaping Mistral’s adoption with our largest customers across a variety of industries. You will be driving deals end2end: from prospective, first intro call until closing and beyond — together with our dedicated implementation specialist, tech and legal teams. Handle customer negotiation end2end, together with our legal and implementation specialist team Executive Engagement: - Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, heads of innovation/AI, and other key decision-makers within target organisations - title: Business Systems Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the systems that turn a signed deal into a correct invoice and accurate revenue numbers. You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering. This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - The big bet: Create a reliable GTM and quote-to-cash foundation across CRM, CPQ, billing and finance systems, marketing automation infrastructure, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. - By day 90, build a clear understanding of the critical data flows between GTM systems, finance systems, and the warehouse, then ship an initial improvement to a high-value integration or workflow. - By day 90, develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that reduce manual work for reps, Deal Desk, and Billing Ops while improving the quality of signals available to reps and operators. - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust. - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure. - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Demonstrated experience in business systems engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, or a technical sales or marketing operations role, with the ability to own problems end to end and work effectively across functions. - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery; you design for clean, traceable data and understand how to protect its integrity across systems. - Experience building integrations with APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, reverse ETL, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io http://Tray.io. Scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building serverless integrations, is a plus. - Familiarity with finance systems and concepts such as quote-to-cash, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition, and the ability to work effectively with Finance and Billing Ops. Experience with an ERP such as NetSuite is a plus. - Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation, following the team’s development and release practices: source control, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and the deployment pipeline - is a plus. - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or a similar CPQ tool — including product and pricing data models, price books, bundles, and approval rules — is a plus. - Genuine curiosity about AI, with experience applying it to day-to-day work through AI-assisted development, agents, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Salesforce administration and customization—including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations—is a plus, not a requirement. title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​ By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence. What excites you Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team. Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials. Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential. Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape. Responsibilities Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases. Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value. Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor. Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production. Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials. title: Procurement & Supply Chain Lead
description: About Hyperscale Power Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical. The role As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale. This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components. What you will do Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production. Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts. Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules. Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues. Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components. Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors. Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks. Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners. Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness. What you bring BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience. Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing. Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing. Specific experience sourcing electronic or mechanical components (semiconductors, PCBs, magnetics, enclosures); experience with contract manufacturers (EMS) is a plus. Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple supplier relationships. Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering and Operations in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving priorities. Fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory. What we offer Equity + competitive salary. Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments. Hybrid work with flexible working times. description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices.
