How you'll make impact You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech. Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility. Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery. Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation. Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon. You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity. Big Four background. Experience building and testing risk controls. A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams. Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures. Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security. Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling. Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity. Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners. Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF. Preferred Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines. Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company. People management experience. Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN. Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications. You'll thrive here if You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You say what you mean. Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform. As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance. title: Senior ML Engineer
description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! What you will do Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation. Support and mentor team members. Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. Your profile 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. Skills Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan. Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring. Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment. Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions. Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience with mentoring and leading team members. title: Business Development Intern
description: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice? At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom. Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together. Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen? During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities. Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work. How you will make a difference Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions. Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts. Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes. Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships. Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions. Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps. Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team. What you bring An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject. Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative. An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply. Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team. Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it. What you can expect High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving. A view of the whole business. You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value. Direct access and room to take initiative. Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment. The opportunity to build a future with us. If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company. You will also benefit from: Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars. A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together! Ready to make a difference? Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? We look forward to meeting you. Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Lead Backend Engineer </strong>in the <strong>Service Standards</strong> team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. platform.</li> <li>Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.</li> <li>Ensure security, privacy, engineering standards across teams.</li> <li>Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have deep leads and engineering leadership.</li> <li>Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! title: Stage Operations & Events | Amsterdam Light Festival | Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
description: Wat ga je doen? Als Operations & Events Stagiair(e) help je mee om onze dagelijkse vaarten soepel te laten verlopen. Je ondersteunt het Operations-team op kantoor en op de kade, met een focus op het Amsterdam Light Festival. Dit is een van de drukste periodes van het jaar. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld bij de planning, coördineert vertrekkende boten en begeleidt gasten bij het instappen. Zo zorg je er samen met je collega's voor dat alles goed verloopt en gasten een fijne ervaring hebben. Je stage is afwisselend, met een combinatie van organiseren en praktisch aanpakken. Wat ga je leren? Helpen bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van het Amsterdam Light Festival; Ondersteunen bij de planning, roosters en administratie; Gasten ontvangen, instappen begeleiden en wachtrijen op de kade coördineren; Contact onderhouden met planners, duty managers, hosts, schippers en havenpartners; Checklists en registraties bijhouden en operationele gegevens verwerken; Meewerken aan projecten en verbeteringen binnen Operations. Praktisch Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk; Duur: 3 tot 6 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Werktijden: Een combinatie van kantoortijden en operationele diensten. Beschikbaarheid in avonden en weekenden is vereist; Stagevergoeding: € 500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en de kade. Wat we aanbieden Een afwisselende meewerkstage waarin je zowel organisatorische als praktische ervaring opdoet; De kans om mee te werken aan de vaarten van het Amsterdam Light Festival en een uniek kijkje achter de schermen te krijgen bij een van de grootste rondvaartoperaties van Amsterdam; Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding. Functievereisten Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in operations, events, hospitality, toerisme of bedrijfskunde; Een betrouwbare, praktische en gastgerichte instelling; Het vermogen om rustig te blijven bij drukte en flexibel omgaan met wisselende taken; Goede beheersing van het Engels, kennis van het Nederlands is een pre; Beschikbaar tijdens het Amsterdam Light Festival (ALF), ook in de avonden en weekenden; Kennis van Excel is een plus. Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
description: Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé! Wie zijn wij? Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is. Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé. Waar kom je te werken? Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren. Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers. Jouw uitdaging Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten. Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid. Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen. Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten; sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid; organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen; bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen; begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen; signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s; initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties; ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers; opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten; tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is; bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé. De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment. Wie ben jij? Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren. Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers. Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. Een contract is voor jou geen statisch document: je gebruikt het als instrument om prestaties te verbeteren, risico’s te beheersen en waarde voor Univé te realiseren. Je bouwt aan professionele leveranciersrelaties waarin transparantie, voorspelbaarheid, continue verbetering en wederzijdse aanspreekbaarheid centraal staan. Je durft leveranciers uit te dagen en weet tegelijkertijd hoe je een constructieve langetermijnrelatie onderhoudt. Verder breng je mee: HBO/HBO+ werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, rechten, economie of een vergelijkbare richting; minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen contractmanagement, bij voorkeur domein IT; aantoonbare ervaring met complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten en leveranciers, binnen het domein IT; kennis van contract lifecycle management, leveranciersrelatiemanagement, prestatiesturing en contractgovernance; ervaring met leveranciersoverleggen, prestatiebeoordelingen, contractevaluaties en escalatiemanagement; kennis van risicomanagement, compliance-eisen en interne beheersing; kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en uitbestedingskaders; bij voorkeur een aanvullende opleiding op het gebied van contractmanagement, zoals CATS, NEVI 2 of vergelijkbaar. Daarnaast herkennen we in jou initiatief, regievoering, risicobewustzijn en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent communicatief sterk, kwaliteitsgericht en analytisch, kunt goed samenwerken en beschikt over overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheden op tactisch-strategisch niveau. Wat bieden wij? We vragen veel van je, maar daar geven we je ook graag veel voor terug: een salaris passend bij jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand; een collectieve prestatiebeloning; een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek; een studiekostenregeling en volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen; een goede pensioenvoorziening; hybride werken: thuiswerken is bij ons heel normaal en je hebt de vrijheid om samen met je team je ideale werkplek te bepalen; een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding op de dagen dat je vanuit huis werkt; een laptop en telefoon; korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen. Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je krijgt bij ons ruimte om impact te maken. Contract- en leveranciersmanagement is binnen Univé volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarmee de mogelijkheid om niet alleen contracten professioneel te managen, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan hoe we ons vakgebied verder vormgeven. Enthousiast? Wil jij samen met ons bouwen aan professioneel contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. Je kunt tot en met 30 november 2026 reageren. title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie. Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken. title: Senior AWS Consultant
description: CloudNation helpt organisaties om het maximale uit de cloud te halen. We combineren diepgaande technische expertise met een pragmatische aanpak en bouwen samen met onze klanten aan schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. We geloven in doen wat werkt: geen dikke rapporten, maar concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Onze consultants staan midden in de uitvoering, werken nauw samen met klanten en zoeken continu naar manieren om te verbeteren en te innoveren met cloud en AI. Wat ga je doen? Als AWS Cloud Consultant sta je midden in de uitvoering: Je ontwikkelt cloudstrategieën en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-oplossingen, op basis van een grondige analyse van de bestaande IT-omgeving en het AWS Well-Architected Framework. Je onderzoekt samen met klanten waar AI echt waarde toevoegt, van slimme automatisering tot generatieve AI met Amazon Bedrock. Je neemt de rol van meewerkend voorman: je stuurt engineers aan en werkt zelf actief mee aan de implementatie van cloudoplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de delivery binnen scope, stelt een Work Breakdown Structure op en bewaakt samen met de projectmanager de voortgang, kwaliteit en planning. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je team volgens het ‘To do, To participate, To do it yourself’-principe. Je zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn en blijft na oplevering betrokken bij optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling. Over deze rol Dit is een senior rol met een duidelijke Customer Lead-overlay. Naast een sterke basis als AWS Cloud Consultant ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en verantwoordelijk voor de waarde die we samen realiseren, over de hele lifecycle. Je combineert technische kennis met leiderschap, neemt teams en partners mee en vertaalt cloudmogelijkheden naar concrete impact. Tegelijk bouw je aan sterke, langdurige klantrelaties en help je zowel de klant als het team steeds een stap verder. Als Customer Lead: Ben je het vaste aanspreekpunt en escalatiepunt voor de klant. Neem je eigenaarschap over de klantroadmap en stuur je op bedrijfswaarde. Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitkomsten van de delivery en stuur je bij wanneer resultaten afwijken van de verwachtingen. Vorm je tijdens Continuous Delivery samen met de People & Process Officer het governance-model richting de klant. title: Principal / Senior Consultant EU Transport & Mobility (Project Delivery & Excellence)
description: Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research About Panteia Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence. The role To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence. This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy. The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners. Key responsibilities Project delivery & leadership Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements. Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination. Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners. Team & quality leadership Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners). Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables. Position in the organisation Reports to: Team manager. Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners. Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility. Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset. Start date: As soon as possible. Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks. Why join Panteia? Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience. Combine analytical depth with real policy impact. Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes. Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus. MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field. Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed. title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
description: Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite. Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours. Ce que vous ferez Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission. Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance. Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée. Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses. Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation. Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être. Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience : Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes. Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission. Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté. Ce que nous cherchons Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes. Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas. La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise. De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole. Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients. Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier. Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris. Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe. Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client. Ce que vous trouverez chez nous Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME. Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année. Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet. Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux. Comment nous recrutons Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape. 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions. 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter. 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés. Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape. Candidature Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.</p> <p>You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</p> <p>GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.</p> <p>You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/chatops/">A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</a></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li>Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li>Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.</li> <li>Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.</li> <li>Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.</li> <li>Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're a globally distributed group of Support OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.</li> <li value="8">Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. The Monetization section includes the Purchase, Subscription Lifecycle, Billing Engine, Platform and Infrastructure, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations, and Compliance teams.</p> <p>This role is on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team and reports to the Engineering Manager, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations. title: Senior AML/CFT Compliance Officer
description: RULEMATCH has built a digital assets trading and clearing venue with world-class partners to meet the specific needs of regulated financial institutions. By offering significantly more capital-efficient and lower latency trading, RULEMATCH is helping increase institutional adoption and enable the next evolution of the crypto and digital asset market. Ensure appropriate documentation and lifecycle management of participant relationships. Review and investigate transaction monitoring and screening alerts, assess potentially suspicious activities and ensure appropriate escalation and documentation. A pragmatic, business-oriented and detail-conscious approach, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset. The ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities and work flexibly when required. An open-minded, solution-oriented attitude, strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. A genuine interest in technology and in optimising compliance systems, processes and technical implementations. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type. More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits. About the role We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next. What we're looking for Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels. High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video. Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign. Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social. Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel. Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round. Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful. AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters. Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale. Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change. Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site Experience 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through. Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus. Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful. Why Benetics AI A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work. Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns. Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work. How we hire Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call A practical case with the team. Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why. You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about a campaign, a piece of content or an AI workflow you built, what you changed and what happened. You don't need a cover letter. title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €210,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Customer Service & Scheduling – German & English
description: Neuchâtel Region | 100% | Temporary 12 months | Start January 2027 Fluent in German and English? Great with customers and strong in coordination? For an international biopharmaceutical company in the Neuchâtel region, we are looking for a German-speaking Site Account Specialist to join an international team supporting treatment centers across Europe. This role is all about communication, coordination and excellent customer service. You will be the key contact for assigned treatment centers, help them manage schedules and processes, solve day-to-day issues and make sure information reaches the right people at the right time. You don't need to be a Cell Therapy expert – you will receive comprehensive training. What matters most is your ability to communicate, organize, take ownership and find solutions. The original BMS profile specifically requires strong customer orientation, scheduling coordination and direct interaction with treatment sites. Site Account Specialist (SAS) -… What you will do Be the main contact for your assigned treatment centers Coordinate patient schedules and ensure information is accurate and up to date Support customers with an online scheduling platform Handle questions and resolve day-to-day issues by phone and email Coordinate with internal teams when changes or problems occur Follow up on open topics and escalate critical issues when needed Maintain customer and scheduling data in internal systems Build strong and trusted relationships with your customers Contribute to a smooth and positive customer experience What you bring We are looking for people with experience in areas such as Customer Service, Customer Care, Account Coordination, Patient Services, Order Management, Logistics or Supply Chain. Around 3 years of relevant professional experience or a Bachelor's degree A genuine customer-service mindset Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Confidence communicating by phone and email The ability to stay calm and solution-oriented when priorities change Good IT skills and the ability to work with several systems and tasks at the same time A proactive attitude and strong sense of ownership Experience in Pharma, Biotech, MedTech or Healthcare is welcome, but not mandatory. Languages – important Fluent German and fluent English are essential. Additional fluent language skills in French, Spanish or Italian are a strong advantage. Contract Start: January 2027 Duration: 12 months, with potential extension up to 24 months Salary: approx. CHF 80'000/year Existing Swiss work permit is mandatory Interested? If you enjoy working with people, coordinating complex processes and finding solutions in an international environment, this could be a great next step. You don't need to know Cell Therapy yet – bring your customer focus, fluent German and English, and organizational talent. We'll take it from there.
