title: Customer Support Specialist 100%
description: Du hast Freude am Kundenkontakt und ein gutes technisches Verständnis? Dann bist du bei Soobr genau richtig! Wir sind ein innovatives Softwareunternehmen mit Sitz in Bern, das mit datengetriebener Technologie das Facility Management neu denkt. Durch die Kombination von Algorithmen und menschlicher Expertise revolutionieren wir die Reinigungsprozesse, fördern Transparenz und Fairness und setzen neue Massstäbe. Unser geografischer Schwerpunkt liegt auf Zentraleuropa, mit der Soobr AG in Bern (Schweiz) und der Soobr GmbH in Hamburg (Deutschland). Das erwartet dich: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und Chat bei technischen oder anwendungsbezogenen Fragen. Du analysierst Anfragen, findest Lösungen, dokumentierst sie und trägst dazu bei, dass sich unsere Kunden gut betreut fühlen und unsere Wissensdatenbank laufend besser wird. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success-, Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam zusammen und gibst wertvolles Feedback aus dem Support-Alltag weiter. Du führst individuelle Schulungen durch und unterstützt unsere Kunden im laufenden Betrieb. Du bringst dein Interesse ein, um bei Tests oder Verbesserungen neuer Produktfeatures mitzuwirken. Das bringst du mit: Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Erfahrung im Customer Support, idealerweise im SaaS-, IT- or Softwareumfeld, oder du kennst die Reinigungs- oder Facility-Branche und möchtest in den digitalen Bereich wechseln. Freude an der Kundenkommunikation und ein sicheres, professionelles Auftreten, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen. Technisches Verständnis und Interesse, Neues zu lernen. Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englisch fliessend, Französisch von Vorteil. Das bieten wir dir: Umfassende Einarbeitung, damit du schnell zum Experten für unser Produkt wirst. Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln Spannende Kundenprojekte im In- und Ausland. Ein motiviertes, offenes Team mit offener Unternehmenskultur und der Vision, das Facility Management zu revolutionieren. Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen am Standort Bern mit der Möglichkeit, 1–2 Tage pro Woche im Homeoffice zu arbeiten Let’s talk! Klingt spannend? Dann erzähl uns, warum du Lust hast, Teil von Soobr zu werden. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) Implementation & Customer Support
description: ORDERMONKEY by SELISE | Zürich | Teilzeit (60+ %) Du interessierst dich für Technologie, Digitalisierung und Gastronomie und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt? Du möchtest neben deinem Studium praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Tech-Unternehmen sammeln, Kunden aktiv unterstützen und Teil eines dynamischen Teams werden? Dann bist du bei ORDERMONKEY genau richtig! ORDERMONKEY ist eine innovative Self-Ordering-Plattform der internationalen Technologie- und Softwareentwicklungsfirma SELISE . Mit unseren digitalen Lösungen – von Self-Ordering-Kiosks über Webshops bis hin zu Payment- und Loyalty-Systemen – unterstützen wir führende Gastronomieunternehmen dabei, ihre Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern. Für unser Team in Zürich suchen wir eine kommunikative, zuverlässige und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit , die uns schwerpunktmässig im Kundensupport unterstützt und gleichzeitig unser Schweizer Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft entlastet. Deine Aufgaben Als Werkstudent bist du Teil unseres Customer-Support- und Operations-Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der direkten Kundenbetreuung, der Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen sowie der Unterstützung unseres Schweizer Teams. Telefonischer Kundensupport: Du bist eine der ersten Ansprechpersonen für unsere Kunden, nimmst eingehende Anrufe auf Deutsch und Englisch entgegen und kümmerst dich professionell um deren Anliegen. First-Level-Support (L1): Du analysierst Kundenanfragen, beantwortest Fragen zur Nutzung unserer Plattform und löst einfache technische sowie operative Probleme selbstständig. Second-Level-Support (L2): Je nach Erfahrung und technischem Verständnis übernimmst du auch weiterführende Supportfälle oder koordinierst diese mit unserem internationalen Support- und Entwicklungsteam. Ticketmanagement: Du erfasst, dokumentierst und bearbeitest Supportanfragen in unserem Ticketsystem, verfolgst offene Fälle und stellst eine strukturierte Weiterbearbeitung sicher. Kundenkommunikation: Du informierst Kunden proaktiv über den aktuellen Bearbeitungsstand und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Anliegen zuverlässig und zeitnah gelöst werden. Administrative Unterstützung: Du unterstützt unser Schweizer Team bei administrativen Aufgaben, internen Abklärungen, Dokumentationen und weiteren operativen Tätigkeiten. Kunden-Onboarding & Installationen: Bei Bedarf hilfst du bei der Vorbereitung neuer Kundenprojekte und unterstützt gelegentlich bei Installationen oder Kundenterminen vor Ort. Wissensmanagement: Du hilfst dabei, Supportanleitungen, FAQs und interne Dokumentationen zu erstellen und unsere Wissensdatenbank kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Dein Profil Du studierst aktuell Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Informatik, Digital Business oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du telefonierst gerne und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt. Du kannst dich gut ausdrücken und bleibst auch bei anspruchsvollen Kundenanfragen freundlich und lösungsorientiert. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du hast ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis und Interesse an Software, digitalen Produkten und modernen Technologien. Du bist kommunikativ, geduldig und behältst auch in hektischen Situationen den Überblick. Du hast Freude daran, Probleme zu analysieren und gemeinsam mit Kunden passende Lösungen zu finden. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundensupport, in der Gastronomie oder im IT-Umfeld gesammelt – dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Du bist bereit, während deiner vereinbarten Arbeitszeiten die telefonische Erreichbarkeit unserer Kunden aktiv sicherzustellen. Ein gültiger Führerausweis der Kategorie B ist bei Stellenantritt Voraussetzung. Was wir dir bieten Praxis statt Theorie: Du sammelst wertvolle Erfahrungen im Kundensupport und im operativen Geschäft eines wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmens. Direkter Kundenkontakt: Du arbeitest mit spannenden Gastronomieunternehmen zusammen und übernimmst eine wichtige Rolle in der Kundenbetreuung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir stimmen deine Einsätze möglichst auf dein Studium und unsere betrieblichen Supportzeiten ab. Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung und kannst eigene Kundenanfragen selbstständig bearbeiten. Internationales Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Schweizer Team sowie internationalen Support- und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Innovative Technologien: Du erhältst Einblicke in SaaS, Payment, POS-Integrationen und digitale Bestelllösungen. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Du kannst dein technisches und operatives Wissen kontinuierlich erweitern und perspektivisch zusätzliche Verantwortung übernehmen. Dynamisches Team: Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit. Interesse geweckt? Du bist kommunikativ, technisch interessiert und hast Freude daran, Kunden aktiv zu unterstützen? Du möchtest neben deinem Studium Verantwortung übernehmen und praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Technologieunternehmen sammeln? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: Junior Public Sector Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p data-start="0" data-end="543"><strong data-start="0" data-end="20">What Is The Role</strong><br data-start="20" data-end="23">Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a Jnr Public Sector Account Exec. You’ll own a greenfield Dutch public sector territory: municipalities, healthcare, education and research. This is a hunter seat with loads of potential, Elastic has the momentum in this segment. You’ll open doors, build champions, and turn Search, Observability and Security use cases into new projects, with a main focus on applying AI.</p> <p data-start="550" data-end="578"><strong data-start="550" data-end="576">What You Will Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and run a territory plan that prioritizes where to hunt first, using account tiering and contact coverage.</li> <li>Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, partners and public sector networks. Many accounts have no contacts yet, so you’ll build coverage from scratch.</li> <li>Run full-cycle deals with MEDDPICC discipline: economic buyer, champion, decision process, paper process.</li> <li>Navigate Dutch public procurement: tenders, Europese aanbesteding, framework agreements, and partner and reseller routes.</li> <li>Expand the existing customers, especially in universities and research.</li> <li>Forecast accurately and keep Salesforce clean.</li> <li>Work with Solutions Architects, partners and Elastic specialists to land technical wins.</li> </ul> <p data-start="1852" data-end="1872"><strong data-start="1852" data-end="1870">What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>We want to hire a sales talent, with <5 years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven new logo track record or proven SDR capacity</li> <li>A preference for Public sector experience in the Netherlands (government, healthcare or education). You understand procurement cycles and can build a deal around them.</li> <li>Experience selling technical solutions in search, observability, security, data or cloud.</li> <li>Fluent Dutch and English. You’ll write and sell in Dutch to Dutch-speaking buyers.</li> <li>Strong qualification habits. You know when to push, when to pivot, and when to walk away.</li> </ul> <p data-start="3285" data-end="3439" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component.</p> <p>At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.</p> <p>The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.</p></div><div class="title">The typical starting On-Target Earnings range (Base Salary + Variable) for this role is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€95.900</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€151.700 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. title: Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer
description: Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do. You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie. This is a role where your work has real reach. What you'll ship A robust, scalable compliance framework across AML/CFT, sanctions, and governance — designed to support Mollie's rapid European expansion Clear, actionable policies and controls that translate PSD2/3, AMLD6 and EBA Guidelines into practical business requirements Proactive risk assessments and thematic reviews that identify and close compliance gaps before they become problems Compliance embedded into product development lifecycles — working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Operations to make it happen by design, not as an afterthought High-quality regulatory reporting and senior management deliverables, prepared with precision and delivered on time A stronger, more capable compliance team — through structured mentorship, coaching, and quality oversight that raises the bar across the board What you'll bring 7+ years of compliance experience within a regulated financial institution — Fintech, PSP, EMI, or (neo)bank Strong, hands-on knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, including PSD2, AMLD, EBA Guidelines and MiCAR Solid experience across both financial crime (AML/CFT, sanctions) and broader regulatory compliance advisory The ability to translate complex regulations into clear, practical solutions — without overcomplicating it Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence senior leadership when it matters A proven track record of mentoring or managing junior compliance professionals and elevating team performance Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Associate Director, Patient Advocacy, Skeletal Dysplasia will develop and execute patient advocacy activities that support BridgeBio’s work in skeletal dysplasia, primarily focusing on Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, and requires fluency in both Portuguese and Spanish. The role has responsibility for the development and execution of the skeletal dysplasia patient advocacy activities in support of clinical development and commercialisation, while safeguarding long-term patient trust and community relationships in support to the Global and International Patient Advocacy strategy</p> <p>Reporting to the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy, this role drives engagement across the skeletal dysplasia community in Latin America, Europe and supports other relevant international and local markets as needed, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making. The Associate Director supports the development of external international partnerships and advocacy and educational initiatives, strengthening meaningful outreach across the region.</p> <h3><strong><u>Key Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary liaison to patient advocacy organizations in Latin America, Europe and other international markets as needed, establishing and strengthening compliant, long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and alignment</li> <li>Support the development of the patient advocacy strategy and implement an international patient advocacy plan for skeletal dysplasia, aligned with the international plan and local priorities</li> <li>Represent BridgeBio at patient advocacy and community meetings across Europe, Latin America and other international markets as needed, building and strengthening relationships with patient organizations and local communities</li> <li>Bring patient and caregiver perspectives into clinical development, medical affairs, regulatory, market access, and commercial planning, as appropriate to the stage of each program</li> <li>Plan and deliver appropriate engagement activities, such as advisory boards, patient organization meetings, educational initiatives, community surveys, patient videos and opportunities to provide input on patient-facing materials</li> <li>Adapt engagement and communications for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking and other international communities, ensuring materials and interactions are culturally relevant and accessible</li> <li>Support the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy in strategic planning and oversight of advocacy-related budgets, including grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and educational initiatives</li> <li>Work with local and international teams to understand differences in care pathways, access barriers, community priorities, and advocacy environments across international markets</li> <li>Coordinate international grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and program budgets in line with applicable policies and local requirements</li> <li>Share clear, actionable community insights with internal partners while protecting individual privacy, preserving patient trust, and maintaining appropriate boundaries</li> <li>Monitor and report changes in relevant policies and industry requirements for patient organization engagement and ensure external activities meet company standards and local laws</li> <li>Promote a patient-first culture by communicating patient and caregiver perspectives, unmet needs, and appropriately consented stories and imagery through internal activities and company materials</li> <li>Strengthen BridgeBio’s role as a trusted partner in the skeletal dysplasia advocacy community through presentations and participation in relevant external forums</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You Will Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This role is based in Europe</li> <li>Frequent travel across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies is required; travel will vary with community and business needs</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a scientific field; advanced degree preferred.</li> <li>5+ years of patient advocacy or community engagement experience, including 3+ years within biotech/pharma.</li> <li>Experience working with rare disease communities; experience with skeletal dysplasia or other genetic rare conditions is preferred.</li> <li>Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is required to engage effectively with patient communities and partners in both languages. Strong professional English is also essential for international collaboration. Knowledge of German and French is an advantage.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with patient organizations across countries and cultures, ideally including Latin America.</li> <li>Understanding of patient engagement requirements, healthcare systems, and access considerations across international markets; familiarity with Europe and Latin American markets is preferred.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a matrixed organization.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel frequently across Europe, Latin America and other relevant geographies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</strong></p> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</p> <ul> <li>Market-leading compensation.</li> <li>Remote/Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community.</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs.</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. title: Werk Student Recruitment
description: Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x) Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Je helpt een groeiend recruitmentteam bouwen aan de manier waarop we mensen aannemen. En als het klikt, willen we je graag laten doorgroeien tot recruiter. Over Eye Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren. Wat ga je doen? Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft. Wie ben jij? Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen Mooi meegenomen Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS Wat krijg je? Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation" Over Eye Security Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst. Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Kijk even welk getal je wilt aanhouden, zodat beide versies hetzelfde zeggen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Let op: deze procedure bevindt zich al in een gevorderd stadium: Marketing director @ Snelstart
description: Vacature: Marketing director (B2B SaaS/fintech) @ Snelstart Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart ( www.snelstart.nl ) in Amersfoort zoekt Sound People een marketing director die marketingstrategie, executie en teamontwikkeling verbindt. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland. Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen. De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart. · Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie. · Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content). · Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales. · Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen. · Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata. · Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat. · Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in. · Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV). Wat biedt Snelstart jou? · Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring. · 30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur) · Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland. · Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage. · Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten. · Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid. · Een betrokken en dynamisch team. Wat is de procedure? Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes. De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de CCO en HR De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de CCO en een externe adviseur. Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT. Slotopmerking Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je! Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer ( Jouw profiel · Aantoonbare resultaten in digitale marketing op strategisch niveau (focus op wat je hebt neergezet). · Ervaring met het leiden/opbouwen van een marketingteam, bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS/tech. · Bewezen succes met leadfunnel‑bouw en marketingautomatisering. · Aantoonbare resultaten met product‑led growth. · Sterk in performance marketing (paid search/social, SEO/SEA, e‑mailautomatisering, retargeting). · Datagedreven, ROI‑gedreven, vertaalt inzichten naar actie. · Pré: HubSpot, Dynamics, Userpilot, AI in marketing (o.a. Breeze AI), B2B‑contentstrategie. Qua motivatie en ambitie zoeken we iemand om marketingkennis intern op te bouwen en afhankelijkheid van bureaus te verkleinen. Die het team neerzet, begeleid en ontwikkeld. Die het ruime marketingbudget inzet en optimaliseert. Daar zit de change en de uitdaging. Qua persoonlijkheid zoeken we iemand die verbinding maakt met de rest van de organisatie, die kwaliteit, energie en humor brengt; cultuur omarmt en ownership heeft. De cultuur is professioneel en no nonsens, dus we zoeken iemand die daar goed bij past. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position Description We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine. Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving. We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure. What you will do Data Architecture & Engineering Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free. Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs. ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions. Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency. Technical Customization & Custom Development Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines. Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages. Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks. API & Ecosystem Integrations Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform. Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync. Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers. Platform Operations & System Health Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime. Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM). Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure. Experience and qualifications Core Technical Competencies Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning. Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman. Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech. MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization. Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements. Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards. What you bring to the team. Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment. Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards. What sets you apart. Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings. Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. You will also drive our "zero to one" product discovery, partnering closely with Product Management, Design, and Science teams to incubate, architect, and launch new, emerging solutions built on top of Planet’s high-frequency imagery and derived data products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.</li> <li>Set a high bar for performance and accountability. engineering execution and delivery for existing flagship products, ensuring reliability and performance for AMS,  Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.</li> <li>Champion and Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.</li> <li>Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.</li> <li>Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant software engineering work experience, including 8+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing multiple layers of engineering management.</li> <li>Experience leading and scaling distributed engineering teams of 50+ employees across multiple geographic locations and time zones.</li> <li>Hands-on engagement with AI tools in your own work, and experience leading engineering teams through AI adoption.</li> <li>Track record of "zero to one" product development, including the technical discovery, architecture, and successful launch of new software solutions.</li> <li>Background in building and delivering geospatial platforms, data analytics solutions, or enterprise SaaS products.</li> <li>Experience delivering tailored solutions to individual customers, meeting or exceeding their expectations and integrating new building blocks back into the solution commons.</li> <li>A growth mindset. You experiment, learn quickly, and change course when the evidence says to.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to translate complex business and user requirements into actionable technical roadmaps.</li> <li>Experience overseeing operational reliability, cloud infrastructure, and software deployment lifecycles for enterprise-grade applications.</li> <li>Ability to drive software delivery metrics, maintain high operational availability/SLAs, and foster rigorous engineering practices.</li> <li>Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain engineering talent at all levels while fostering an inclusive team culture.</li> <li>Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Success building large scale civil government solutions leveraging forward deployed engineering. </li> <li>Familiarity with the unique regulatory, compliance, and security requirements of government technology solutions globally.</li> <li>Experience building sovereign systems for governments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. title: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Make security the reason people trust Ockto Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture. As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide. What you'll do You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you: Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible. Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to. Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time. Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls. Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes. Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA. Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering. Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents. Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM. Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember. Who you work with You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you. You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second. Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM. What you bring You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who: • Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar. • Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits. • Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM. • Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs. • Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed. • Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer. • Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes. • Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage. Will be a plus: • CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification. • Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs. • Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators. • Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000. • Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets. • Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment. What you get You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto. • Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us. • A real mandate : a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk. • Influence on what we build next , as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions. • Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work. • Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance. Ockto also offers: • A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience • Room and budget for personal and professional development • A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice • Phone and travel allowance • Great home and remote working facilities • Lunch fee • Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere. About Ockto Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time. Ockto. Built for trust. Ready to join? Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions. Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture , core values and recruitment process , or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com . Your data is safe At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks. description: Afstudeeropdracht: Ontwerp een innovatief product voor de groei van 12Build! Over 12Build 12Build is een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en zo de samenwerking in de bouw makkelijker en transparanter maakt. We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We hebben meer dan 90 collega’s op kantoren in Nijverdal en Zwolle. Ons platform wordt dagelijks gebruikt in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken, en we willen heel Europa veroveren. Met zo’n snelle groei liggen er veel vragen klaar waar nog niemand goed antwoord op heeft. Daar zoeken we jou voor. De opdracht We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Je gaat samen met Ed, je begeleider vanuit 12Build, uitzoeken welke uitdaging het beste past bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert. Ontwerpvraag (startpunt): Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen: • AI en kennisdeling: hoe zetten we AI in om klanten en gebruikers te helpen, bijvoorbeeld met cursussen of leercontent in de 12Build Academy?. • Groei en leadgeneratie: hoe trekken we meer nieuwe klanten aan en volgen we leads slimmer op, bijvoorbeeld met lead scoring of automatisering?. • Self-service: hoe zorgen we dat gebruikers zelf de weg vinden op het platform en sneller een betalend account nemen?. • Internationale groei: hoe pakken we een nieuwe markt aan en wat werkt in Nederland wel of juist niet in Duitsland of Denemarken?. • Klantbeleving en data: hoe halen we meer uit klantdata, reviews en feedback om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren?. • Jouw eigen idee: zie je een kans die hier niet tussen staat? Dan horen we dat graag.. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.” Wie is 12Build? 12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren. Wie zoeken we? • Een hbo- of wo-student die gaat afstuderen in bijvoorbeeld marketing, bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, business innovation, communicatie, AI of een vergelijkbare studie;. • Iemand die zelf ideeën aandraagt en het leuk vindt om iets nieuws neer te zetten;. • Iemand die beschikbaar is vanaf februari 2027, voor de duur van je afstudeerperiode;. • Iemand die Nederlands spreekt. Duits of Engels is een pluspunt.. Wat bieden we? • Een stagevergoeding;. • Een eigen opdracht met echte impact in een internationaal en snelgroeiend bedrijf;. • Begeleiding door een ervaren collega en een team van zeven marketeers;. • Een platte organisatie waarin jouw ideeën gehoord worden;. • Thuis en op kantoor werken, een relaxruimte met pooltafel, tafeltennis en FIFA, en geregeld uitjes en teamdagen.. title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
description: WAT GA JE DOEN? Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen. title: Customer Success  - Team Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. </p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.</strong></p> <p>To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies. </p> <p>You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.</p> <p>We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This opportunity is available in the APAC region and is remote.</p> <p><strong>The role entails:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic planning and analysis:</strong> preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.</li> <li><strong>Customer interactions and support to your team:</strong> resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.</li> <li><strong>Team management:</strong> passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.</p> <p>Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.</p> <p><strong>This role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.</li> <li>Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.</li> <li>Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.</li> <li>Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.</li> <li>Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.</li> <li>Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.</li> <li>Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.</li> <li><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/travel" target="_blank">Travel internationally</a> a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation</li> <li>Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.</li> <li>Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques</li> <li>Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal</li> <li>Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree</li> <li>Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP</li> <li>Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)</li> <li>Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.</li> <li>Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Staff-level Software Engineer for Identity Management</strong> to work on <span style="font-weight: 400;">authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our</span><a href="https://canonical.com"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">canonical.com</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and</span><a href="https://ubuntu.com"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">ubuntu.com</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products. In addition, you will help write <a href="https://juju.is/">Juju</a> charms to manage operational concerns.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.</span></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate proactively with frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and Python</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Review code produced by other engineers, helping set quality standards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write <a href="https://juju.is/">Juju</a> charms (operators) to manage operational concerns</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You are a staff-level or experienced senior software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition:</span></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team conferences in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination.
